summary.core_problem: 能否用“同一 backbone + 少量 PEFT 参数”的 block-diffusion drafter，在 speculative decoding 中实现真实可用的端到端加速。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是负结果/工程剖析：指出“accepted prefixes 不等于速度提升”，把 speculative decoding 的瓶颈从算法层拉回到系统与算子成本层，对后续设计 drafter 形态很有约束力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出/评估 PEFT-BD：在目标 AR 模型上挂 LoRA 类 adapter 作为 drafter，用类似 BD3LM 的去噪目标并行提议一段 token block，由原模型 verifier 接受/拒绝；优势是无 tokenizer mismatch、无需加载独立 draft 模型、参数增量小。通过 profiling 发现每步 speculative 仍需“adapter-enabled 的全 backbone draft pass”，导致吞吐收益被计算开销抵消。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上实验；方法能产生非平凡 accepted prefixes，但整体不产生实用加速；结论主要来自端到端 profiling（摘要未给出具体加速比/接受率数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether a same-backbone, PEFT-parameter-only block-diffusion drafter can deliver practical end-to-end speedups for speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: A negative result with profiling: shows that accepted prefixes are not sufficient for real speedups, constraining future drafter designs by highlighting system/compute overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluates PEFT-BD: attach a LoRA-like adapter as a block-diffusion drafter on the same AR backbone, trained with a BD3LM-style denoising objective to propose token blocks in parallel, verified by the AR model. Despite avoiding tokenizer mismatch and a separate draft model, profiling shows each speculative step still requires an adapter-enabled full-backbone draft pass, wiping out throughput gains.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B; achieves nontrivial accepted prefixes but no practical speedup; conclusions rely on end-to-end profiling (no exact speedup/acceptance numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 这是“别被接受率骗了”的硬核负结果：重点看 profiling 结论，drafter 复用 backbone 基本注定算不过账。
recommendation.en: A useful “acceptance rate isn’t speed” negative result—read the profiling; same-backbone drafters tend to lose on compute economics.

paper.title: RSLoRA: Training-free Rank Allocation for LoRA via Representational Sensitivity Probing
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT); however, the conventional practice of uniform rank assignment ignores the functional heterogeneity of neural layers. Existing rank allocation methods typically struggle with a trade-off between computational intensity and heuristic simplicity: training-based methods suffer from prohibitive overhead, while pre-allocation methods fail to capture the dynamic task-specific representation manifold. In this

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 中各层 rank 通常统一分配、无法反映层间功能差异的问题，同时避免训练式 rank 搜索带来的额外成本。
summary.importance: 贡献是 PEFT 侧的训练-free rank allocation 方法；对 LLM 后训练成本控制有参考，但摘要信息显示其主要投向并不明确是大语言模型，相关性有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RSLoRA，用 activation-space geometry 做 Representational Sensitivity Probing。方法通过 structured low-rank noise 模拟适配过程，测量虚拟更新对内部表征的影响，再据此给不同层分配 rank；不需要梯度，也不需要实际训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务、数据集、baseline 或提升幅度。它声称现有训练式方法开销高、静态预分配方法过于启发式，RSLoRA 在此二者之间提供训练-free 的任务敏感分配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles non-uniform rank allocation for LoRA, where uniform ranks ignore layer heterogeneity while training-based allocation is expensive.
summary_en.importance: It is a PEFT-method contribution with some relevance to post-training cost control. Its relevance to foundation LLM research is modest because the provided abstract does not establish large-scale LLM experiments.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSLoRA uses activation-space geometry to probe representational sensitivity. It injects structured low-rank noise as a virtual adaptation signal, measures how internal representations would shift, and assigns ranks accordingly without gradients or training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model families, task suites, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The main claim is that RSLoRA avoids both the cost of training-based allocation and the brittleness of static heuristics.

recommendation.zh: LoRA rank probing 思路可作 PEFT 备查；没有 LLM 大规模 setup 时，不要把层敏感性结论外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a PEFT reference for rank probing; without large-LLM setups, do not extrapolate its layer-sensitivity claims to pretraining.

paper.title: ReCoLoRA: Spectrum-Aware Recursive Consolidation for Continual LLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts a large language model to one task cheaply, but across a task sequence LoRA-style methods keep stacking low-rank updates on the same frozen weight, so each new task tends to overwrite the previous ones. We present ReCoLoRA (Recursive Consolidation of Low-Rank Adapters), a spectrum-aware framework for continual fine-tuning: adapters are initialized from a randomized SVD of the pretrained weight, per-layer effective ranks are selected by an elbow criterion, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效微调在连续任务序列中反复叠加低秩更新、导致旧任务能力被新任务覆盖的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练与 continual fine-tuning 方法改进。它不直接推进预训练目标或数据配比，但对长期维护一个基座模型的多轮适配、adapter 合并和能力遗忘有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReCoLoRA。方法先用预训练权重的随机 SVD 初始化 adapter，再用 elbow criterion 为每层选择有效秩；训练时先适配主子空间，再逐步开放残差容量。每个新任务开始前，它不回到原始预训练权重，而是对当前已吸收前序任务的 effective weight 重新分解，得到冻结残差、慢速更新主成分和新的 adapter。
summary.experiments: 在六任务 continual GLUE 序列上测试四个 7B-8B 级别 backbone。摘要称 ReCoLoRA 在四个 backbone 中有三个取得最高 final average score，并与常规 LoRA/continual PEFT 设定对比。摘要未给出完整数值和所有 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses catastrophic overwriting in sequential LoRA-style fine-tuning, where multiple low-rank updates are stacked on the same frozen base weight.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and continual adaptation contribution rather than a pretraining method. It is relevant for maintaining long-lived foundation models through repeated task adaptation and adapter consolidation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCoLoRA initializes adapters from a randomized SVD of pretrained weights, selects per-layer effective ranks using an elbow criterion, adapts the principal subspace before opening residual capacity, and recursively re-decomposes the current effective weight before each new task into a frozen residual, a slowly updated principal component, and a fresh adapter.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on a six-task continual GLUE sequence across four 7B-8B backbones. The abstract reports the best final average score on three of the four backbones against continual PEFT baselines, but does not provide full numerical details.

recommendation.zh: 这是 continual PEFT 的干净小改法；看 adapter 重分解逻辑即可，不必按预训练方法读。
recommendation.en: A clean continual-PEFT tweak; read the recursive adapter decomposition, not as a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: CORA: Per-Slice Coherent Orthogonal Rotation for SVD-based Low-Rank Adaptation
paper.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) commonly adapts pretrained weights through low-rank updates, and recent methods further exploit the singular value decomposition (SVD) of the base weight for initialization or subspace selection. However, these methods do not explicitly preserve the coupled geometry between the pretrained left and right singular bases. Motivated by recent minimum-perturbation theory, which shows that stable finetuning follows a coherent SVD rotation in which a single orthog

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 PEFT 中如何更有效地利用预训练权重的 SVD 几何结构。现有 LoRA 和 SVD-LoRA 类方法通常把谱值变化和奇异基旋转混在一个低秩增量里；正交微调方法能显式旋转，但不改变奇异值。作者要解决的问题是：能否用很少参数，同时表达预训练权重奇异基的相干旋转和谱方向的可控变化。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练算法论文，但对理解预训练权重的可适配几何有一定启发。论文把“最小扰动微调”中的 coherent SVD rotation 观点落到 per-slice adapter 上，说明稳定适配可能不需要任意低秩增量，而是沿着预训练权重已有奇异结构做受约束的旋转。对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口的意义在于：如果这种结构性适配稳定成立，后训练阶段可以反过来提供关于预训练权重可塑性和冗余方向的信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 CORA，即 Per-Slice Coherent Orthogonal Rotation Adaptation。作者先把权重矩阵按行切成 slices，对每个 slice 做 SVD，并证明全局 coherent rotation 的最小扰动形式可以推广到 per-slice 粒度。实现上，CORA 只作用于原权重的 rank-r 重构 W_lr=U0,r Σ0,r V0,r^T，冻结残差 W0-W_lr。每个 slice 学一个共享的正交旋转 Qi，使左奇异基和右奇异基以相干方式变化，同时保留一个谱方向的参数化空间。Qi 通过 learnable skew-symmetric matrix 的 Cayley map 参数化，保证训练过程中严格正交，不需要额外正则或投影。参数量为每个线性层约 1/2·m·(r-1)，作者称在相同 rank 下约为 LoRA 的四分之一。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类任务：8 个 commonsense reasoning 任务、HumanEval 代码生成、GSM8K 和 MATH 数学任务；模型包括 LLaMA-2-7B、LLaMA-3-8B 和 Mistral-7B。LLaMA-2-7B commonsense 上，CORA 用 6.6M 参数达到 82.16%，超过 LoRA、DoRA、PiSSA、MiLoRA 等基线，并且参数约少 8×。代码任务上，LLaMA-3-8B 和 Mistral-7B 在 HumanEval Pass@1 分别达到 48.2 和 40.2，参数量为 10.3M，比 LoRA、DoRA、LoRI、DiaBlo 少约 4–12×。实验重点是参数-性能 trade-off，而不是绝对能力边界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 LoRA、SVD-LoRA、orthogonal finetuning 三类方法缺口的定位；看理论部分的 per-slice coherent rotation 定理，理解它对全局最小扰动形式做了什么近似和限制；看 Method 中 Cayley map 参数化和 rank-r reconstruction + frozen residual 的设计。实验部分优先看参数量对齐方式和 commonsense/HumanEval 主表。需要谨慎的是：理论假设依赖稳定预训练权重和最小扰动目标，任务实验仍是下游 PEFT，不能直接推出预训练阶段的优化规律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a PEFT method should use the SVD geometry of a pretrained weight. Standard LoRA and SVD-based LoRA variants mix basis rotation and spectral change inside one low-rank additive update. Orthogonal finetuning exposes rotation but keeps singular values fixed. The target is a parameter-efficient adapter that can represent coherent rotations of pretrained singular bases while preserving a controlled spectral degree of freedom.
summary_en.importance: This is a PEFT paper, not a pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is in the geometry of pretrained weights. It turns the minimum-perturbation view of fine-tuning into a concrete per-slice adapter, suggesting that useful adaptation may live in structured rotations of existing singular coordinates rather than arbitrary low-rank directions. This is informative for the pretrain-posttrain interface: adapters can reveal which parts of a pretrained weight are stable, plastic, or redundant.
summary_en.technical_approach: CORA, or Coherent Orthogonal Rotation Adaptation, partitions a weight matrix into row slices and applies an SVD-aware parameterization to each slice. The paper proves a per-slice analogue of the coherent rotation form: under the assumed minimum-perturbation setting, the left and right singular bases should be transformed by a shared orthogonal rotation. In implementation, CORA operates on the rank-r reconstruction W_lr=U0,r Σ0,r V0,r^T and freezes the residual W0-W_lr. Each slice learns an orthogonal Qi, parameterized through a Cayley transform of a learnable skew-symmetric matrix, so orthogonality is exact during training without projection or penalty terms. The resulting parameter count is about 1/2·m·(r-1) per linear layer, roughly one quarter of LoRA at matched rank according to the paper.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover eight commonsense reasoning tasks, HumanEval, GSM8K, and MATH, using LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-3-8B, and Mistral-7B. On LLaMA-2-7B commonsense reasoning, CORA reaches 82.16% with 6.6M trainable parameters, outperforming LoRA, DoRA, PiSSA, and MiLoRA under a much smaller parameter budget, reported as about 8× fewer parameters. On HumanEval, it reaches 48.2 Pass@1 with LLaMA-3-8B and 40.2 with Mistral-7B using 10.3M parameters, about 4–12× fewer than several compared PEFT methods. The main evidence is a better parameter-performance trade-off, not a new upper bound on downstream accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Read the introduction for the gap between additive LoRA, SVD-LoRA, and orthogonal finetuning. Then inspect the per-slice coherent rotation theorem and the assumptions behind it. In the method section, focus on the Cayley parameterization and the choice to adapt only the rank-r reconstruction while freezing the residual. For experiments, check how parameter budgets are matched and how the commonsense and HumanEval tables are constructed. The main caveat is that the theoretical framing relies on stability and minimum-perturbation assumptions, while the empirical evidence remains downstream PEFT.

recommendation.zh: Cohere 出品的 PEFT 改进，从理论上指出了现有 SVD 初始化 LoRA（如 PiSSA）的几何缺陷并给出了修正方案，做 Post-train 的同学值得一看其参数化设计。
recommendation.en: A PEFT improvement from Cohere that theoretically points out the geometric flaws of existing SVD-initialized LoRA (like PiSSA) and provides a correction; worth a look at the parameterization design for post-train researchers.

paper.title: FRAME: Learning the Adaptation Domain with a Mixture of Fractional-Fourier Experts
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reparameterizes weight updates in a fixed basis: low-rank adapters operate in the spatial domain, while a recent line of spectral methods operates in a fixed Fourier domain. We argue that the choice of domain is itself a design degree of freedom that should be learned, and that no single basis is optimal across tasks, layers, or tokens. We introduce Fractional-Fourier Mixture of Experts, a mixture-of-experts adapter in which every expert carries a learnable

summary.core_problem: 解决 PEFT 方法中 LoRA 固定在空间域、谱方法固定在傅里叶域，单一基无法在不同任务/层/token 上最优的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将分数阶傅里叶域作为可学习自由度引入 MoE 适配器，实现空间-谱连续统上的自适应低秩更新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FRAME：分数阶傅里叶 MoE 适配器，每个专家携带一个可学习的分数阶傅里叶阶数，连续插值于空间域（等价 LoRA）和傅里叶域（等价谱适配器）；不同阶数的分数阶傅里叶算子天然互不相干，减少专家间干扰，token 被路由到低秩更新最紧凑的域。
summary.experiments: 在多种下游任务上对比 LoRA、谱适配器及其他 PEFT 方法，验证在相同参数预算下性能更优，且专家路由呈现出跨层、跨任务的域偏好差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that PEFT methods fix low-rank updates in either the spatial domain (LoRA) or a fixed Fourier domain (spectral adapters), with no single basis optimal across tasks, layers, or tokens.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first introduces learnable fractional-Fourier domain choice into a mixture-of-experts adapter, enabling adaptive low-rank updates along a continuous spatial-spectral continuum.
summary_en.technical_approach: FRAME (Fractional-Fourier Mixture of Experts) equips each expert with a learnable fractional-Fourier order that continuously interpolates between the spatial domain (recovering vanilla LoRA) and the Fourier domain (recovering spectral adapters); operators of different orders are mutually incoherent, naturally reducing expert interference, and tokens are routed to the domain where each low-rank update is most compact.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against LoRA, spectral adapters, and other PEFT methods across multiple downstream tasks; achieves better performance under the same parameter budget, with routing revealing layer- and task-dependent domain preferences.

recommendation.zh: PEFT 方向的增量创新，分数阶傅里叶插值思路可作 LoRA 变体备查，不影响预训练主流程。
recommendation.en: Incremental PEFT innovation; the fractional-Fourier interpolation idea is worth keeping as a LoRA variant reference, does not affect the main pretraining pipeline.

paper.title: When Top-1 Fails: Calibrating LoRA Monitors for Masked Diffusion LMs
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language model (DLM) fine-tuning inherits inexpensive diagnostics from denoising-time confidence monitors, but their PEFT-training meaning is untested. We test top-1 argmax concentration as a collapse warning. Across 816 LoRA/PEFT configurations from three DLM families, the warning fires for every configuration while logs record 0/816 actual collapses at the 200 step horizon, giving zero precision. The cause is pre-equilibrium saturation: top-1 concentration is already high be

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是一个很具体但容易误用的问题：离散扩散语言模型在 LoRA/PEFT 短程训练中，能否把 denoising 阶段已有的 top-1 argmax concentration 当作训练崩溃预警。作者的结论是否定的。top-1 监控的是 token 预测分布是否集中，但 DLM 在训练前和训练早期已经高度集中，这个信号很快饱和，不能区分后续稳定与不稳定的 LoRA 配置。论文进一步寻找替代信号，提出用 LoRA 参数侧的最大梯度范数做 family-local triage，即只在同一 DLM 家族内校准阈值，用于早期检查和实验路由。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在训练诊断，而不是提出新的 DLM 训练目标。它给出了一个大规模负结果：一个在 denoising 诊断中看似廉价、自然的 token-side 指标，迁移到 DLM-LoRA PEFT 稳定性监控时完全失效。对预训练研究的启发在于，监控信号的语义高度依赖训练阶段和参数更新路径。DLM 的 token 预测集中不等于参数更新已经危险；LoRA 的风险更可能出现在梯度如何路由到少数低秩矩阵上。这个观察对扩散 LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练仪表盘设计有直接意义：不能简单复用 AR 或 denoising 过程中的可视化指标，需要区分 token-side saturation 和 parameter-side instability。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分成两步。第一步是反证 top-1 collapse warning。作者在 816 个 DLM PEFT 配置上做审计，覆盖 LLaDA-family 的 671 个配置、Dream-7B 的 100 个边界配置、MDLM-OWT 130M 的 45 个边界配置。top-1 collapse rate 度量 argmax 预测是否集中到很小的词表区域。结果显示该 warning 在 816/816 配置上触发，但训练日志中的 collapsed flag 在 200 step 训练窗口内为 0/816。这个指标的 precision 为 0。第二步是解释为什么失效，并提出替代监控。作者测到 top-1 token frequency 在 step 0 已经是 0.83±0.13，所有配置都高于 0.5，中位配置在 4 个 optimizer steps 内超过 0.95。legacy fire-step 与稳定性无显著关系，Mann–Whitney U 检验 p=0.20。相比之下，参数侧的 LoRA 梯度更能反映不稳定配置。作者检查了 worst rank-amplification corner：per-token CE 梯度集中度并不高，Gini 为 0.29，最大 token-position CE-gradient share 只有 1.5%；但 LoRA 参数梯度更集中，Gini 为 0.46，单个矩阵承载 63.0% 的梯度质量。基于这个观察，论文用 max LoRA gradient norm 做早期 triage，并强调阈值必须按模型家族校准，不能跨 family 直接迁移。
summary.experiments: 关键实验有四组。第一，816 个 DLM 配置中，top-1 warning 全部触发，实际 collapse 为 0，precision 为 0。匹配的 AR 控制实验使用 Pythia 410M、1B、2.8B、6.9B 和 Qwen3.5-9B，共 360 个审计配置，也记录到 0/360 actual collapses，说明结果不是一般的 masked-CE collapse 现象。第二，饱和分析显示 top-1 在优化开始前已经处于高位：step 0 为 0.83±0.13，所有配置超过 0.5，中位配置 4 step 内超过 0.95，且触发时间与稳定性无显著关系。第三，max-gradient 与不稳定配置显著相关。在 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，n=144，不稳定配置的 median max-gradient norm 是稳定配置的 3.23 倍，Bonferroni 校正后 p=2.7e-7，bootstrap 95% CI 为 [2.76, 3.97]。在 method-comparison set 上，n=395，比例达到 362 倍，稳定配置 median 为 99.3，不稳定配置 median 为 35,960.4，pBonf=5e-21，CI 为 [202, 779]。第四，held-out 校准实验更关键。作者在 LLaDA-family 的 671 个配置上做固定 80/20 split，在训练集选择阈值，用来预测测试集 top-decile final-loss 配置。max-gradient 达到 precision 0.68、recall 0.94、F1 0.79；all-positive top-1 baseline 在同一 split 上 precision 只有 0.13。split-bootstrap 的 95% CI 为 [0.500, 0.947]，高于 baseline ceiling 0.148。step-k sweep 还显示 max-gradient 的 precision 从约 step 25 起趋于稳定；loss-at-step-k 在 step 11 对极端高 loss 配置更强，但在 step 25 到 100 之间落后于 max-gradient。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、§4.1、§4.5 和 Limitations。§4.1 是核心负结果，重点看 816 配置的 warning/collapse 对照，以及 held-out threshold calibration。§4.5 是机制解释，重点看 token-side saturation 与 LoRA parameter-side gradient routing 的分离。Appendix B.1 值得看，因为 step-k sweep 回答了一个实际问题：多早记录 max-gradient 才有用。Appendix C 的 AR controls 用来界定结论范围，避免把问题误解成普通交叉熵训练都会这样。Appendix D 的 falsification probes 值得快速过一遍，主要看作者如何限制 claim：它支持的是 short-horizon DLM-LoRA PEFT 的 inspection/routing，不是通用 collapse detector。实现上最值得借鉴的是监控设计原则：先问指标测到的是 token 分布、loss 轨迹还是参数更新路径，再决定它能不能作为训练稳定性信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important monitoring failure in discrete diffusion language models: whether top-1 argmax concentration, a cheap diagnostic already used during denoising, can serve as an early collapse warning for short-horizon LoRA/PEFT training. The answer is no. Top-1 concentration measures token-side prediction saturation, and in these DLM runs it is already high before meaningful optimization begins. It quickly loses sensitivity to downstream training stability. The paper then proposes a family-calibrated parameter-side signal, the maximum LoRA gradient norm, as an early inspection and routing tool.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly diagnostic. It does not introduce a new DLM objective, but it gives a well-controlled negative result on a monitoring practice that is easy to adopt without validation. For pretraining researchers working on diffusion LMs or masked/any-order LMs, the main lesson is that a monitor’s meaning depends on the training phase and the update path. Token-level concentration during denoising is not the same thing as a dangerous parameter update during LoRA training. The useful signal comes from where gradients are routed in the low-rank adapters. This is directly relevant to building training dashboards for non-AR language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first audits top-1 collapse warnings across 816 DLM PEFT configurations: 671 LLaDA-family configurations, 100 Dream-7B boundary configurations, and 45 MDLM-OWT 130M boundary configurations. The warning fires for every configuration, while the training loop records zero actual collapses at the 200-step horizon. The authors then explain the failure through saturation analysis. Top-1 token frequency is already 0.83±0.13 at step 0, every run is above 0.5, and the median run crosses 0.95 within four optimizer steps. The warning fire-step is not significantly associated with stability. The alternative signal is parameter-side: maximum LoRA gradient norm. A gradient routing probe shows that token CE gradients are only mildly concentrated, with Gini 0.29 and the largest evaluated token-position share at 1.5%, while LoRA parameter gradients are much more concentrated, with Gini 0.46 and one matrix carrying 63.0% of the gradient mass. This motivates using max-gradient as a family-local triage signal rather than a global threshold.
summary_en.experiments: The central result is the 816-configuration refutation: top-1 fires in 816/816 DLM PEFT runs, while actual collapse occurs in 0/816 runs, giving zero precision. Matched AR controls on Pythia 410M, 1B, 2.8B, 6.9B, and Qwen3.5-9B cover 360 audited configurations and also show 0/360 actual collapses, helping bound the claim. The saturation analysis reports step-0 top-1 frequency of 0.83±0.13, all runs above 0.5, median crossing 0.95 within four optimizer steps, and no significant relation between legacy fire-step and stability, with Mann–Whitney U p=0.20. For max-gradient, unstable configurations in LLaDA2.0-mini have a 3.23x higher median max-gradient norm than stable ones, with n=144, Bonferroni-corrected p=2.7e-7, and bootstrap 95% CI [2.76, 3.97]. On the method-comparison set, n=395, the ratio is 362x, with stable median 99.3 versus unstable median 35,960.4, pBonf=5e-21, CI [202, 779]. On a fixed 80/20 split of the 671-configuration LLaDA-family corpus, a threshold selected on the training split predicts held-out top-decile final-loss configurations with precision 0.68, recall 0.94, and F1 0.79. The all-positive top-1 baseline gives precision 0.13 on the same split. A split-bootstrap gives 95% CI [0.500, 0.947], above the baseline ceiling of 0.148. A step-k sweep shows max-gradient precision stabilizing around step 25.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, §4.1, §4.5, and the Limitations closely. §4.1 contains the key audit result and the held-out calibration protocol. §4.5 is the most useful part mechanistically, because it separates token-side pre-equilibrium saturation from LoRA parameter-side gradient routing. Appendix B.1 is worth reading for the step-k sweep, which answers when the signal becomes useful in practice. Appendix C defines the AR controls. Appendix D is useful for the falsification probes and for understanding the limits of the claim. The most transferable idea is not the exact threshold, but the monitoring principle: decide whether a signal measures token distribution, loss trajectory, or parameter update routing before using it as a stability alarm.

recommendation.zh: 所有做扩散LM预训练/微调的团队应立刻废弃top-1浓度崩溃预警，复现其LoRA梯度范数监控逻辑到训练pipeline中。
recommendation.en: All teams working on diffusion LM pre-training/fine-tuning should immediately discard top-1 concentration collapse warnings and reproduce its LoRA gradient norm monitoring logic in training pipelines.

paper.title: Parallel Manifold Steering: Efficient Adaptation of Large Associative Memories via Residual Energy Shaping
paper.abstract: Large Transformer models function as Dense Associative Memories (DAMs), retrieving knowledge via high-dimensional attractor dynamics driven by the self-attention mechanism \citep{ramsauer2020hopfield, wu2024attention}. However, adapting these frozen memory systems to new tasks presents a fundamental ``Plasticity-Stability'' dilemma. Current methods either risk catastrophic interference by modifying synaptic weights directly (e.g., LoRA) \citep{hu2021lora} or degrade associative capacity by clogg

summary.core_problem: 尝试在不改 frozen Transformer 权重、也不增加 prompt token 的前提下，为大模型引入可学习的任务适配机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是架构化适配方法。论文把 Transformer 视为 dense associative memory，并将参数高效适配表述为对激活流形和能量景观的控制问题；这个视角与机制分析有一定关系，但摘要中的表述偏概念化，是否有干净的大规模 LLM 实证还不清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 H-Res，即 Hierarchical Residual Steering。它学习状态相关的向量场，在激活空间中调整 token trajectory，使 token 被引向任务相关吸引子；目标是在不改变全局平衡、不修改主干权重、不扩展序列长度的情况下完成适配。相对于 LoRA，它避免直接改权重；相对于 visual/prompt tuning，它避免占用上下文位置。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型参数量、任务、数据集、baseline 数值或提升幅度。可确认的实验设定不足，因此目前更适合作为 adaptation/energy-shaping 思路备查，而不是作为可靠训练 recipe 采纳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes adapting frozen Transformer memory systems without modifying backbone weights or adding prompt tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural adaptation proposal. It casts Transformers as dense associative memories and parameter-efficient adaptation as control over the activation manifold and energy landscape. The framing is relevant to mechanism-oriented adaptation, but the abstract does not establish strong large-scale LLM evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed H-Res, or Hierarchical Residual Steering, learns a state-dependent vector field that steers token trajectories toward task-specific attractors. It aims to preserve the global equilibrium of the frozen model while avoiding both direct weight updates, as in LoRA, and sequence-length expansion, as in prompt tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains. The available information is not enough to judge whether the method survives realistic LLM-scale adaptation settings.

recommendation.zh: 能量景观叙事有意思，但先找实验表；若只在小模型成立，就当作 PEFT 备查概念。
recommendation.en: The energy-landscape framing is interesting, but check the experiment tables first; if it is small-scale only, treat it as PEFT background.

paper.title: ARIADNE: Agnostic Routing for Inference-time Adapter DyNamic sElection
paper.abstract: The increasing deployment of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has led to model ecosystems in which a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters. In this setting, inference-time queries often arrive without task labels, requiring the system to automatically select the most appropriate adapter from a growing and heterogeneous adapter pool. Existing routing methods either depend on access to adapter internals, such as weight decompositions or gradient-based statistics, or r

summary.core_problem: PEFT生态中，单骨干模型搭配大量任务专用适配器，推理时无标签输入无法自动选择最优适配器，现有路由方法依赖适配器内部信息或额外训练，扩展性与可移植性差
summary.importance: 工程向方法创新，提出训练无关、适配器无关的推理时动态路由框架，无需修改适配器权重或额外训练即可实现适配器选择
summary.technical_approach: 提出ARIADNE框架：1）用各适配器训练集的嵌入计算质心，表征对应任务的数据分布；2）推理时计算输入嵌入与各质心的距离，选择最近的适配器执行推理
summary.experiments: 在多适配器场景下验证，相比现有路由方法，在无需额外训练的前提下取得相当或更优的适配器选择准确率，未披露具体量化数据

summary_en.core_problem: In PEFT ecosystems, a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters, and unlabeled inference queries cannot automatically select the optimal adapter. Existing routing methods rely on adapter internal information or additional training, with poor scalability and portability
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented method innovation: training-free, adapter-agnostic dynamic routing framework for inference-time adapter selection, no adapter weight modification or extra training required
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ARIADNE framework: 1) compute centroids from embeddings of each adapter's training set to represent the corresponding task's data distribution; 2) measure distance between input embedding and each centroid during inference, select the nearest adapter
summary_en.experiments: Verified in multi-adapter scenarios, achieved comparable or better adapter selection accuracy than existing routing methods without extra training; no specific quantitative data disclosed

recommendation.zh: PEFT多适配器部署的工程方案，做多模型/多适配器推理系统时可参考路由思路，仅看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Engineering solution for multi-adapter PEFT deployment, reference routing design only when building multi-adapter inference systems, read method section only

paper.title: Catastrophic Forgetting is Low-Rank: A Function-Space Theory for Continual Adaptation
paper.abstract: Catastrophic forgetting in continual adaptation is usually studied through parameter drift, replay, or distillation, but these views do not identify which output-space directions are vulnerable. We give a function-space account in the NTK regime: new-task training induces old-task prediction drift through the cross-task kernel, yielding a closed-form predictor for the forgetting vector before any new-task gradient step. In frozen-backbone linear-head PEFT-CL, where the model is linear in the tra

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 continual adaptation 中的遗忘到底发生在输出空间的哪些方向，而不只是度量参数漂移或旧任务准确率下降。核心问题是：在新任务训练前，能否用可计算的函数空间量预测旧任务预测值会如何漂移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 continual pretrain、instruction tuning 和 PEFT-CL 的诊断层面。论文把遗忘从参数空间问题改写为 NTK 诱导的函数空间干扰问题，给出一个可预测、可分解的视角。它的贡献不是提出一个新的通用抗遗忘算法，而是说明遗忘常集中在少数旧任务 NTK 特征模态上。这对设计 replay、正则化、adapter/LoRA 更新约束有直接启发：如果遗忘是低秩的，保护所有参数或所有输出方向都可能过宽，针对 vulnerable subspace 的方法可能更有效。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从两任务 continual regression 出发：模型先在 Task A 上得到参数 θ_A，再从 θ_A 出发训练 Task B。作者在 θ_A 处做 NTK 线性化，用 Task B 的残差 r_B 和任务间 kernel K_AB 推导旧任务预测漂移：Δf_A ≈ -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B。这里 K_AB 是 Task A probe 输入与 Task B 训练输入之间的跨任务 NTK，K_BB 是 Task B 自身 NTK。关键点是这些量都在 Task B 更新前、θ_A 处计算，因此可以预先预测遗忘方向和幅度。对于冻结 backbone、只训练共享线性 head 的 PEFT-CL 场景，模型对可训练参数是线性的，因此该预测近似退化为数值精度内的精确结果。对于 adapter、LoRA 或 full fine-tuning，它是局部 NTK 近似。论文进一步分析 K_AA 的特征分解，说明 Δf_A 落在 Im(J_A)=Im(K_AA) 中，并且能量集中在少数 eigenmodes。在线性 head 情况下，K_AA 还可写成输出维度与 feature Gram 的 Kronecker 结构，从而给出 vulnerable rank 约为 C × k_G 的缩放规律。
summary.experiments: 主要实验证明预测式在冻结 backbone + 线性 head 设置下几乎精确。Split-MNIST、Split-CIFAR-10 上，预测遗忘向量与真实遗忘向量的 cosine similarity 大于 0.99；在 ViT-B/16 和 DINOv2 等 transformer backbone 上，1 - cosine similarity 可低至 1e-6 量级；冻结 ResNet-18 上 cosine similarity 约为 0.994。谱分析显示，旧任务遗忘能量集中在很少的 Task-A NTK eigenmodes 中：在 Split-MNIST/CIFAR-10 上，1 到 6 个模态即可承载 50% 到 90% 的遗忘能量。论文还用 spectral regularization 作为验证工具，显示在共享 head benchmark 上有稳定收益，但作者明确把它定位为理论诊断的实证支持，而不是主要算法贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Theory 部分，重点看 Proposition 1 的推导，以及 Δf_A = -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B 这个式子如何连接新任务残差、跨任务 kernel 和旧任务漂移。然后看低秩结构与 Kronecker factorization 的段落，这是对 PEFT-CL 最有用的部分。实验部分优先看 Figure 1、Appendix C 中线性 head 精确性的验证，以及 eigenmode energy concentration 的图表。预计阅读 30 到 45 分钟即可把主线读完；如果要借鉴到 continual pretrain 或 LoRA 训练约束，需要细读附录中的 NTK 计算和 frozen-backbone 设定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which output-space directions are vulnerable during continual adaptation. Instead of treating forgetting as parameter drift or a scalar drop in old-task performance, it tries to predict the actual old-task prediction shift before any new-task update is taken.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining-oriented work is diagnostic. Continual pretraining, instruction tuning, and PEFT-based maintenance all face forgetting, but many mitigation methods regularize parameters or replay data without identifying the function-space directions that drift. This work shows that, in a useful linearized regime, forgetting is often concentrated in a small number of NTK eigenmodes. That suggests a more selective design space for replay, distillation, and adapter constraints: protect the vulnerable function subspace rather than penalizing all parameter movement uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis considers two-task continual regression. After training on Task A, the model is at θ_A; Task B training starts from this point. The model is linearized around θ_A, and the Task-A prediction shift induced by Task-B training is derived in closed form: Δf_A ≈ -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B. K_AB is the cross-task NTK between Task-A probe inputs and Task-B training inputs, K_BB is the Task-B NTK, and r_B is the Task-B residual evaluated at θ_A. The important operational detail is that all terms are computed before Task-B optimization. In frozen-backbone linear-head PEFT, the model is exactly linear in the trainable parameters, so the predictor is exact up to numerical precision. For LoRA, adapters, and full fine-tuning, it becomes a local NTK approximation. The paper then decomposes the shift in the eigenbasis of K_AA and shows that the forgetting vector lies in the image of the Task-A Jacobian. For a frozen backbone with a trainable shared linear head, K_AA admits a Kronecker structure, yielding an effective vulnerable rank on the order of C times the feature-Gram effective rank.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical results support the function-space predictor in the regimes where the assumptions are appropriate. On Split-MNIST and Split-CIFAR-10, the predicted and realized forgetting vectors have cosine similarity above 0.99. With frozen transformer backbones such as ViT-B/16 and DINOv2 under linear-head adaptation, the mismatch reaches float32-level precision, with 1 - cosine similarity around 1e-6 in the appendix. A frozen ResNet-18 case reports cosine similarity around 0.994. Spectral measurements show that forgetting energy is highly concentrated: on Split-MNIST/CIFAR-10, only 1 to 6 Task-A NTK eigenmodes account for roughly 50% to 90% of the energy. Spectral regularization is used as an instrument to validate the diagnosis and gives consistent gains on shared-head settings, but it is not positioned as the central contribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the derivation of Proposition 1 and the spectral interpretation that follows it. The key equation is the closed-form predictor involving K_AB, K_BB, and the Task-B residual. The most relevant experimental evidence is in Figure 1, the eigenmode concentration plots, and the appendix results for frozen ViT/DINOv2 linear heads. Budget around 30–45 minutes for the main argument. Readers interested in applying the idea to LoRA or continual pretraining should spend extra time on the assumptions behind the NTK linearization and the Kronecker factorization for shared linear heads.

recommendation.zh: 函数空间视角的低秩遗忘结论对持续预训练的PEFT设计有参考，重点看§3的NTK推导与遗忘秩的Kronecker缩放规则。
recommendation.en: The low-rank forgetting finding from the function-space view informs PEFT design for continual pretraining; focus on §3 NTK derivations and the Kronecker scaling rule.

paper.title: Beyond LoRA: Is Sparsity-Induced Adaptation Better?
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and its variants provide a memory- and compute-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning of pre-trained models. However, questions remain about the comparative generalizability of these approaches and how the structural restrictions on low-rank updates preserve effective adaptation performance. We present a historical framing, covering the past (full fine-tuning and original LoRA), the present (different variants of LoRA), and propose simpler, cheaper, parameter-effici

summary.core_problem: LoRA及其变体在参数高效微调中是否存在泛化性差距？低秩结构约束是否限制了适配能力？
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出更简单更便宜的稀疏诱导LoRA变体（cLA和c³LA），并给出了信息论泛化误差界，属于对PEFT工具链的增量扩展。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Cheap LoRA（cLA）：只训练一个低秩因子，另一个固定（确定性或随机化）；以及链式循环变体c³LA。将cLA建模为非对称LoRA的结构化实例，等价于对全量微调的列子空间约束。推导了信息论泛化误差界。
summary.experiments: 摘要中未提供具体模型规模、数据集或对比数据，论文似乎偏理论推导。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多所大学，无知名机构或知名作者识别。

summary_en.core_problem: Do LoRA and its variants have a generalization gap in parameter-efficient fine-tuning? Do low-rank structural constraints limit adaptation capacity?
summary_en.importance: Methodological incrementalism: proposes simpler and cheaper sparsity-induced LoRA variants (cLA and c³LA) with information-theoretic generalization bounds, extending the PEFT toolchain.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Cheap LoRA (cLA): trains only one low-rank factor while fixing the other (deterministic or randomized); and chained circulant variant c³LA. Frames cLA as a structured asymmetric LoRA instance, equivalent to column-subspace restriction of full fine-tuning. Derives information-theoretic generalization error bounds.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, dataset, or comparison results are provided in the abstract; the paper appears偏重 theoretical derivation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from multiple universities; no well-known institutions or researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: PEFT变体的又一增量，理论界推导有一定参考价值但无经验SOTA证明，作为literature备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Another incremental PEFT variant with some theoretical generalization bounds but no empirical SOTA demonstration; file as literature reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: The Hidden Power of Scaling Factor in LoRA Optimization
paper.abstract: In Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the scaling factor $α$ is often treated as a mere complement to the learning rate, yet its role in optimization remains poorly understood. In this paper, we reveal that the scaling factor $α$ and the learning rate function differently, with $α$ emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone. Through the synergy of extensive empirical analysis and a theoretical Signal-Drift framewo

summary.core_problem: 解释 LoRA 中 scaling factor α 的真实优化作用，并判断它是否只是学习率的等价缩放。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练优化分析。它把 LoRA 中常被经验调参处理的 α 单独拿出来，指出 α 与 learning rate 在优化动态上不等价，这对 PEFT recipe、rank 选择和超参迁移有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Signal-Drift 分析框架，把 LoRA 更新拆成任务信号放大与参数漂移两部分；核心判断是 LoRA 的低秩谱抑制会让损失景观更平滑，默认超参偏保守，而增大 α 可以放大有效任务信号，同时不等比例提高漂移风险。论文还给出最优 α 与 rank 的次线性关系，摘要中提到可用平方根形式刻画。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了大规模经验分析，但未给出具体模型规模、任务集合和提升数字。可确认的实验结论包括：单纯放大学习率不能复现增大 α 的收益；α 是更主要的优化驱动因素；最优 scaling factor 随 rank 次线性增长。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what the LoRA scaling factor α actually does in optimization, and whether it is merely interchangeable with the learning rate.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimization analysis for post-training and PEFT. It isolates a hyperparameter that is usually treated as a tuning detail, and argues that α changes the training dynamics in a way that learning-rate scaling cannot reproduce.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a Signal-Drift framework that separates useful task signal amplification from parameter drift. Their main mechanism is that LoRA’s spectral suppression smooths the optimization landscape, making standard hyperparameters conservative; increasing α exploits this smoothness by amplifying task signal without proportionally increasing the drift ratio. They further propose a sublinear, approximately square-root, relationship between the optimal α and the LoRA rank.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive empirical analysis but does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. The stated findings are that α dominates effective LoRA optimization, learning-rate scaling alone cannot match its gains, and the best α grows sublinearly with rank.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Signal-Drift 推导和 rank-α 曲线；若结论稳，LoRA recipe 里把 α 当学习率别名的习惯该改。
recommendation.en: Read the Signal-Drift derivation and the rank–α curve; if robust, the common habit of treating LoRA α as a learning-rate alias should be dropped.

paper.title: Advancing the State-of-the-Art in Empirical Privacy Auditing
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) can exhibit problematic memorization of individual training examples. Empirical privacy auditing (EPA) quantifies this risk by measuring realistic data leakage on membership inference (MI) or reconstruction attacks. A key challenge in EPA is designing ``canary'' examples that are mixed with the privacy-sensitive training data. We propose generating synthetic canaries via high-temperature sampling ($T \geq 0.8$) from LLMs, using prom

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：在 LoRA 等参数高效微调场景下，如何设计足够强、又不依赖真实隐私数据的 canary，用来更可靠地审计训练样本记忆与泄漏风险。已有 EPA 方法的瓶颈不只在攻击器，也在 canary 本身。太随机的 canary 容易脱离模型可学习范围，尤其在 LoRA 容量有限时未必被记住；太贴近真实数据的 canary 又可能需要访问敏感分布，审计过程本身会引入隐私成本。论文还处理了一个更细的问题：当只发布由微调模型生成的合成数据时，泄漏不一定表现为逐字复现，而可能是分散在整批合成数据里的弱分布偏移。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续训练研究的影响主要在数据治理与训练风险测量。它把隐私审计从“攻击某个模型输出是否复现训练样本”推进到更可操作的训练前插桩方案：用非隐私、可重复插入、可人工检查的合成 canary 测量不同 LoRA 容量、不同 canary 熵、不同发布形式下的记忆强度。对企业内部 continual pretrain、领域微调、合成数据释放都有直接参考价值。贡献量级不在模型能力提升，而在审计信号质量：canary 设计变强后，MI 和 reconstruction attack 的结论更接近最坏情形风险，避免低估 PEFT 对个体样本的记忆。
summary.technical_approach: 方法有两个核心。第一，用待审计模型同源的 instruction-tuned LLM 生成合成 canary，并通过高温采样控制 canary 熵。实验使用 Gemma3 12B 生成并微调，top_p=1.0，温度覆盖 T≥0.8。高温采样会压平 token 分布，使文本在统计上更罕见，但仍保留语法和语义结构。这个设计比随机字符串更容易被语言模型学到，也比真实样本派生 canary 更安全，因为只需要知道敏感数据的大致格式，比如邮件格式，而不需要读取具体隐私内容。第二，提出针对合成数据发布的代理审计：先用被审计的微调模型生成将要释放的合成数据，再训练一个辅助 attack LLM；如果某个 canary 曾影响原模型，合成数据中的分散信号会被辅助模型吸收到参数里，使该 canary 在辅助模型下获得更高似然。这样可以把“数据泄漏审计”转成标准的模型级 membership inference，而不是只查逐字匹配或单条样本相似度。这个思路的关键差异是聚合弱信号，而不是等待显式复现。
summary.experiments: 实验设置围绕 Gemma3 12B、Enron email corpus、LoRA 微调和 synthetic canary 展开。论文系统比较了不同 canary 类型、不同采样温度、不同 LoRA rank，以及两类攻击目标：直接审计微调模型，和审计由微调模型生成后准备发布的合成数据。主要结论有三点。第一，高温合成 canary 在 LoRA 场景下比文献中的基线 canary 给出更强的 MI 和 reconstruction 信号，说明它们同时满足“可学到”和“可区分”。第二，辅助 attack LLM 的合成数据审计比逐字复现或语义相似度检索更敏感，能捕捉 canary 对生成分布的弱影响。第三，LoRA rank 与 canary 熵存在交互：rank 越高，最大化记忆的 canary 熵越高；而 reconstruction attack 偏好的 canary 熵低于 MI attack。这个结果很有用，因为它说明审计强度不是单调依赖“越异常越好”，而是受模型可塑性和攻击类型共同控制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Synthetic Canary Design、合成数据审计方法、LoRA rank 与 canary entropy 的实验图表。重点看三个问题：一是高温采样为什么比随机 token 或真实数据改写更适合 PEFT 审计；二是辅助 attack LLM 如何把合成数据里的分散泄漏信号转成似然差异；三是 rank、temperature、MI/reconstruction 三者的消融关系。附录里的 prompt、canary 示例、使用不同模型生成 canary 的实验也值得看，因为这些细节决定方法能否迁移到内部语料和不同模型族。预计精读时间 1.5 到 2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a measurement problem in empirical privacy auditing for parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning: how to construct canaries that are strong enough to expose memorization, while not requiring access to private records. Existing canaries face a tradeoff. Highly out-of-distribution strings may be identifiable but not learnable under limited LoRA capacity. Realistic canaries can reassure users but may require touching sensitive data. The paper also targets a harder release setting: leakage through synthetic data, where the signal may be distributed across many generated examples rather than appearing as exact regurgitation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to privacy-aware continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and synthetic data release. It improves the auditing substrate rather than the attack algorithm alone. By using inspectable, non-private, repeatable synthetic canaries, the audit can probe group privacy and worst-case memorization without increasing risk to real users. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the interaction between data rarity, model capacity, and memorization under LoRA. The results argue that privacy auditing should be calibrated to the adaptation capacity and the attack type, not treated as a fixed post-hoc checklist.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. First, canaries are generated by prompting an instruction-tuned LLM, typically from the same model family as the audited model, with high-temperature sampling. In the reported setup, Gemma3 12B is used with top_p=1.0 and temperatures at or above 0.8, targeting Enron-style email data. Increasing temperature flattens the sampling distribution, producing text that is unusual enough to create a measurable gradient signal but still syntactically and semantically coherent. This differs from random canaries, which can be too far from the model’s language manifold, and from private-data-derived canaries, which complicate the privacy accounting. Second, the paper introduces a proxy audit for synthetic data. The released synthetic dataset is used to fine-tune an auxiliary attack LLM. If a canary influenced the original fine-tuned model, its signal can be aggregated into the auxiliary model weights, making the observed canary more likely than matched unobserved canaries. This bridges data auditing and model-level membership inference.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses Gemma3 12B, LoRA fine-tuning, and the Enron email corpus. It compares synthetic high-temperature canaries against prior canary designs under membership inference and reconstruction attacks, both on the fine-tuned model and on synthetic data generated from it. The paper reports that high-temperature synthetic canaries produce stronger attack signals than literature baselines in the LoRA setting. The proxy audit based on an auxiliary attack model is more sensitive than audits based on verbatim regurgitation or direct semantic similarity. A key ablation varies LoRA rank and canary entropy: the entropy level that maximizes memorization increases with LoRA rank, while reconstruction attacks peak at lower entropy than membership inference attacks. This suggests that memorization is governed by a balance between identifiability and learnability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction, the synthetic canary construction section, the proxy synthetic-data audit method, and the figures that sweep LoRA rank and canary entropy. The most important implementation details are the prompt format, temperature choice, and whether the canary generator is the same model family as the audited model. The appendix examples are useful because the practical success of this audit depends on canaries being unusual without leaving the target data format. A focused read should take about 90 to 120 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 canary 生成和 synthetic-data audit 两节；这会改变隐私审计里“canary 要像真实样本”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the canary generation and synthetic-data audit sections; it challenges the default assumption that audit canaries should look like ordinary records.

paper.title: The Fine-Tuning Trap: Evaluating Negative Transfer and the Role of PEFT in Sub-1B Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge devices requires efficient fine-tuning strategies that adapt models to new tasks without degrading their general capabilities. In this study, we benchmark five sub-1B models (135M-1B) on mathematical reasoning tasks and uncover a critical vulnerability: Full Fine-Tuning (Full FT) actively harms performance in models under 300M parameters, often dropping accuracy below zero-shot baselines. This "negative transfer" makes Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tunin

summary.core_problem: 研究 sub-1B 小模型在数学推理任务上微调时的负迁移问题，以及 PEFT 是否比全量微调更稳。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但和 pretrain↔post-train 接口有关：它指出在小模型 regime，后训练并非总是“越强监督越好”，全量微调可能直接破坏已有能力。对小模型 recipe、mid-train 和 alignment 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较五个 135M-1B 模型在数学推理上的 Full FT、LoRA、DoRA 与 few-shot ICL 表现，重点分析参数规模与调参方式如何影响负迁移。核心结论是：在 300M 以下模型，全量微调常不稳定，而 PEFT 更像是能力保护机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测了五个 sub-1B 模型，包含 Qwen2.5-0.5B、SmolLM2-135M 等；在 GSM8K、OrcaMath 等任务上，300M 以下模型做 Full FT 往往低于 zero-shot，LoRA/DoRA 更稳，其中 DoRA 在复杂推理上更强，LoRA 在模式匹配型任务上更优。没有看到更大规模或更干净的控制变量，因此结论更适合作为小模型经验法则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies negative transfer in mathematical-reasoning finetuning for sub-1B language models, and whether PEFT is more stable than full finetuning.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters at the pretrain↔post-train interface: in the small-model regime, stronger supervision is not always better, and full finetuning can actively damage existing capabilities. That is relevant to small-model recipes, mid-training, and alignment design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors benchmark five 135M-1B models on mathematical reasoning under Full FT, LoRA, DoRA, and few-shot ICL, focusing on how parameter scale interacts with adaptation strategy. The central claim is that below roughly 300M parameters, PEFT behaves more like a capability-preserving constraint than just an efficiency trick.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions five sub-1B models including Qwen2.5-0.5B and SmolLM2-135M, with tasks such as GSM8K and OrcaMath. It reports that Full FT often falls below zero-shot performance for models under 300M, while LoRA/DoRA are more stable; DoRA helps more on complex reasoning and LoRA on pattern-heavy tasks. Without stronger controls, this reads more as a useful small-model heuristic than a universal law.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但对小模型很实用：别默认 full FT 更强，<300M 先把 LoRA/DoRA 当稳定性约束看；读表格就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a new paradigm, but practical for small models: stop assuming full FT is stronger; below ~300M, treat LoRA/DoRA as stability constraints first and read the tables.

paper.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
paper.abstract: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA -- costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. We introduce Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead. Co

summary.core_problem: 解决代码模型在仓库级理解中必须注入 repository context，但长输入 RAG 有推理开销、逐仓库 LoRA 又难以适应代码持续演化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是代码模型与仓库级适配方向的工程方法，和基座预训练不是一条主线，但对“把外部上下文压缩成参数化适配器”这一思路有一定启发，尤其适合看作 inference-time context 与 parameter-side memory 的替代关系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Code2LoRA，用 hypernetwork 从仓库内容生成 repository-specific LoRA 适配器，以零额外推理 token 的方式注入仓库知识。分为两种场景：Code2LoRA-Static，把单次仓库快照映射成适配器；Code2LoRA-Evo，用 GRU 隐状态按代码 diff 持续更新适配器，面向活跃演化中的代码库。作者还构建了 RepoPeftBench，用于和参数高效微调基线比较。
summary.experiments: 基于 604 个 Python 仓库构建 RepoPeftBench，包含 static 与 evolving 两个 track；摘要给出 static track 有 40K 训练样本和 12K 评测样本。比较对象应包括 RAG、依赖分析注入、逐仓库 LoRA/PEFT 等方法。摘要没有给出具体 backbone、参数规模和提升幅度，因此当前更像一个值得知道的 repo-level adaptation 方案，而不是必须跟进的基础模型结论。
summary.authors_note: 滑铁卢大学。作者名单中未见可明确确认的基座模型领域标志性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses repository-level code understanding, where code LMs need repo context but long-input RAG is expensive and per-repository LoRA is brittle under ongoing software evolution.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering method for code models rather than a core pretraining paper, but it is mildly interesting as a parameter-side alternative to inference-time context injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters from repository content, injecting repository knowledge with zero extra inference tokens. It has two modes: Code2LoRA-Static maps a repository snapshot to an adapter, while Code2LoRA-Evo maintains an adapter through a GRU state updated by code diffs for evolving repositories. The paper also introduces RepoPeftBench for evaluation against PEFT baselines.
summary_en.experiments: RepoPeftBench covers 604 Python repositories with static and evolving tracks; the abstract states 40K training and 12K evaluation examples for the static track. Baselines likely include RAG-style context injection, dependency-based retrieval, and per-repository LoRA/PEFT. The abstract does not expose backbone sizes or exact gains, so this looks more like a useful repo-adaptation design than a must-track foundation-model result.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Waterloo. No clearly identifiable frontier-lab foundation-model authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“把长上下文仓库知识蒸成 adapter”这个角度值得记一下；只看方法图和 benchmark 设定即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of distilling long repository context into adapters is worth noting; the method figure and benchmark setup are probably enough.

paper.title: On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is usually treated as a cheaper alternative to full fine-tuning. We study a broader role: small trainable adapters as persistent local state on top of strong shared foundation models. In this framing, the base model provides shared competence while adapters carry instance-specific behavior such as preferences, skills, tool habits, and memory-like updates. We organize the problem around three scaling axes: Scale Up, where stronger shared priors make small lo

summary.core_problem: 研究 PEFT 不只作为低成本微调方案，而是作为强共享基座模型之上的持久个性化状态载体。
summary.importance: 贡献在于重新组织 PEFT 的问题框架：把小 adapter 看作用户偏好、技能、工具习惯和记忆式更新的承载层，重点不在单次微调效果，而在大规模个人模型的管理与服务形态。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕 Scale Up、Scale Down、Scale Out 三个轴分析 PEFT：更强基座如何提高小 adapter 的有效性，adapter 可以缩到多小仍保持可靠，以及大量持久 adapter 如何共存。MinT 被作为基础设施例子，用于管理 adapter 身份、版本、来源、评估和 serving residency。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 或提升幅度，只说明目标场景是 trillion-parameter shared foundation model 上承载 million-level personal adapters。
summary.authors_note: Mind Lab 工作，作者列表包含 Song Cao、Vic Cao、Kaijie Chen 等；摘要未提供可确认的代表性既有工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies PEFT not merely as cheap fine-tuning, but as persistent personalized state on top of a strong shared foundation model.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a framing shift: small adapters are treated as carriers of preferences, skills, tool habits, and memory-like updates, with emphasis on lifecycle management and serving many personalized model instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study is organized around three axes: Scale Up, where stronger shared priors make small local updates more useful; Scale Down, where the minimum reliable adapter size is examined; and Scale Out, where many persistent adapted instances coexist. MinT is presented as an infrastructure example for adapter identity, revision, provenance, evaluation, and serving residency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains, beyond targeting million-scale personal adapters over trillion-parameter shared foundation models.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Mind Lab, with authors including Song Cao, Vic Cao, and Kaijie Chen; no confirmed prior representative work is available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 框架比实验更有用；只看 Scale Out 和 MinT 设计，作为个性化 post-train serving 的问题清单。
recommendation.en: The framing is more useful than the results; read Scale Out and MinT as a checklist for personalized post-training serving.

paper.title: FoRA: Fisher-orthogonal Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning(PEFT) has largely focused on LoRA and its accuracy-oriented variants, leaving the original goal of reducing trainable parameters has receivedcomparatively little attention. We introduce FoRA, which revisits this goal by reducing the number of adapted layers rather than adapter rank. FoRA selects task-informative layers via a single-pass diagonal Fisher score (under 1% of training cost) and trains the LoRA down-projection at selected layers on the Stiefel manifold,

summary.core_problem: PEFT研究过度聚焦LoRA的精度导向变体，忽视了减少可训练参数的原始目标；现有方法主要通过降低秩来压缩参数，导致有效秩损失。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出通过选择层而非降低秩来减少参数的PEFT新路径，将Fisher层选择与Stiefel流形上的正交约束训练结合。
summary.technical_approach: FoRA包含两个核心组件：(1) 用单次对角Fisher评分以不到1%训练代价选择任务信息丰富的层；(2) 在Stiefel流形上训练所选层的LoRA下投影矩阵，保持列正交性和有效秩。两个组件具有超加性组合效应。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA、Qwen3、Gemma家族的12个骨干模型上测试（270M到32B参数），FoRA以LoRA/DoRA一半的参数预算持续超越它们，以AdaLoRA四分之一的参数数达到其精度的0.7-0.8个百分点内。

summary_en.core_problem: PEFT research has overly focused on accuracy-oriented LoRA variants, neglecting the original goal of reducing trainable parameters; existing methods primarily compress via rank reduction, which loses effective rank.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a new PEFT path that selects layers rather than reducing rank, combining Fisher-based layer selection with orthogonality-constrained training on the Stiefel manifold.
summary_en.technical_approach: FoRA has two core components: (1) single-pass diagonal Fisher scoring selects task-informative layers at <1% of training cost; (2) trains LoRA down-projection matrices at selected layers on the Stiefel manifold to preserve column orthonormality and effective rank. The two components combine super-additively.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 12 backbones from LLaMA, Qwen3, and Gemma families (270M to 32B params); FoRA consistently outperforms LoRA and DoRA at half their parameter budget, and matches AdaLoRA within 0.7-0.8 accuracy points at one-quarter its parameter count.

recommendation.zh: PEFT领域的扎实增量改进，两个组件的超加性效应值得关注；对基座研究员主要看§4层选择分析，不影响预训练核心方法论。
recommendation.en: Solid incremental PEFT work with interesting super-additive component effects; read §4 for layer selection analysis, but does not shift pretraining methodology.

paper.title: On the Construction and Implications of Low-Loss Valleys in LoRA-based Bayesian Inference
paper.abstract: While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like low-rank adaptation (LoRA) are standard for large language models, principled estimation of epistemic uncertainty remains challenging. Recent results in the LoRA regime suggest that discrete multi-mode approaches such as deep ensembles offer little benefit over single-mode methods. This contradicts broader observations in deep learning, where ensembling independent optima typically improves generalization, and linking these modes through continu

summary.core_problem: 研究LoRA参数空间中是否存在可连接独立解的低损失谷，以及这种结构是否能改善贝叶斯模型平均与不确定性估计。
summary.importance: 这是针对PEFT/LoRA几何结构与不确定性建模的分析型工作。它不直接推进预训练，但对理解LoRA解空间、集成失效原因和后训练不确定性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LoRA-Curve，用分段 Bézier 曲线在 LoRA 空间中连接多个解，包含自由优化和锚定独立LoRA最优点两种版本；并给出路径连续性与低秩约束下的构造分析，用于沿曲线做贝叶斯模型平均。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和任务，只说明比较了单模态方法、深度集成和基于低损失谷的BMA，关注函数多样性、泛化和不确定性收益。若实验主要停留在LoRA微调任务，其外推到大规模基座训练的价值有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether independently fine-tuned LoRA solutions are connected by low-loss valleys, and whether such structure can improve Bayesian model averaging and uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis-oriented study on PEFT/LoRA geometry and uncertainty. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it may be useful for understanding LoRA solution space, why ensembles underperform, and how post-training uncertainty behaves.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces LoRA-Curve, a segmented Bézier-curve parameterization in LoRA space, with both a free variant and an anchored variant that connects independently trained LoRA optima. The method is used to perform Bayesian model averaging along low-loss paths.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets. It indicates comparisons against single-mode methods and deep ensembles, focusing on functional diversity, generalization, and uncertainty gains. If the setup is limited to LoRA fine-tuning tasks, the implications for large-scale foundation training remain indirect.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练距离较远，但若你关心LoRA解空间是否真是‘单盆地’，可只看方法设定和低损失连接结果，别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not very close to pretraining, but worth a quick look if you care whether LoRA really lives in a single basin; read the low-loss connectivity result and avoid over-generalizing.

paper.title: DynaGraph: Lightweight Multi-Model Interaction Framework via Dynamic Topological Reconfiguration
paper.abstract: Tackling complex reasoning tasks typically relies on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. While task decomposition through structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations offers an alternative, these approaches inevitably fall into a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are highly vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat. To address this, we present Dyn

summary.core_problem: 复杂推理任务中，静态拓扑多Agent易出现级联错误，无约束动态Agent易轨迹发散、内存膨胀，且部署算力成本高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出兼顾鲁棒性和部署效率的轻量多Agent动态拓扑框架。
summary.technical_approach: 执行层在共享基座模型上复用时分PEFT适配器，支持单消费级GPU完成全系统训练与部署；路由层通过Evaluator监控执行置信度，触发细粒度修补或子图重构两类自愈机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体量化实验结果与对比基线。

summary_en.core_problem: For complex reasoning tasks, static-topology multi-agents are prone to cascading errors, unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and memory bloat, and deployment cost is high.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a lightweight multi-agent dynamic topology framework balancing robustness and deployment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Execution layer multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling full system training and inference on a single consumer GPU; routing layer monitors execution confidence via Evaluator, triggering two self-healing mechanisms: fine-grained patching and subgraph reconstruction.
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative experimental results or baselines are disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 共享基座+时分PEFT做多Agent的思路有一定参考价值，仅看路由层自愈机制部分即可，不用通读。
recommendation.en: The shared base + time-division PEFT multi-agent design offers minor reference value, only read the routing-level self-healing section if needed.

paper.title: NaRA: Noise-Aware LoRA for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive generative paradigm. Given the prohibitive computational cost of full fine-tuning, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the standard approach. However, existing PEFT methods (e.g., LoRA), originally tailored for autoregressive models, rely on static parameters that are agnostic to the noise level. Consequently, they ignore the intrinsic dynamics of the diffusion process, where input distributions

summary.core_problem: 如何在扩散式语言模型（dLLM）的多步去噪过程中做参数高效微调：传统 LoRA 的增量权重对所有噪声步共享且“噪声无感”，导致在高噪声阶段几乎不起作用，整体适配效率与上限受限。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏“扩散 LM 的适配/训练接口”而非基座预训练本身，但对做 diffusion/any-order LM 的研究团队很实用：它把“扩散过程的时间步/噪声条件”显式引入 PEFT 结构，给出一种低开销的连续条件化适配方式。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：提醒大家 diffusion LM 的训练/适配信号在不同噪声段分布差异很大，静态 adapter 会系统性失配；后续做 continual pretrain、mid-train 或 task adaptation 时，可能需要把噪声段当作一等公民来设计目标与参数化。
summary.technical_approach: NaRA 的核心是把 LoRA 的固定低秩更新 ΔW=BA 替换为“静态投影 + 动态核心”的分解：两侧投影矩阵保持可训练但不随噪声变，核心低秩矩阵由一个轻量、全局共享的超网络（hypernetwork）根据噪声水平/时间步条件生成，从而得到随噪声连续变化的更新 ΔW(t)=B·C(t)·A。直觉上，A/B 学到跨噪声段共享的子空间，而 C(t) 负责在该子空间内按噪声难度调节方向与幅度。作者也讨论了“为不同时间步训练多套 LoRA（Multi-LoRA）”的朴素方案：它参数开销线性增长且割裂了噪声段之间的共享结构；NaRA 用连续函数形式把共享与差异统一起来。文中还给出表达能力分析：在该分解下，可以等价表示多组不同的更新矩阵（对应不同噪声段/时间步），说明这种结构不会因为共享而显著损失可表达性。
summary.experiments: 全文实验围绕 LLaDA 系列 dLLM（Base 与 Instruct）做 PEFT，对比标准 LoRA、Multi-LoRA 等噪声无感/分段噪声感知基线，覆盖常识推理、数学推理、代码生成三类任务。关键现象是：作者在 LLaDA 的数学推理设置中先做了诊断实验（Figure 1）：标准 LoRA 在低到中噪声段能明显降低交叉熵，但在高噪声段相对 baseline 改善很小，支持“静态 adapter 在扩散早期失效”的论点。随后 NaRA 在多个基准上取得更稳定的收益，并声称在保持极小额外开销的同时达到/刷新同类 PEFT 的最好结果；同时分析显示 hypernetwork 生成的更新幅度会随噪声水平系统性变化，符合“高噪声更需要不同更新形态”的预期。你给到的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（提升幅度、rank、参数量占比、训练步数/显存等），精读时需要直接对照主结果表与消融表确认收益主要来自哪些噪声段、哪些层、以及是否对不同任务一致。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1) 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：把“LoRA 在高噪声段不工作”这个诊断结论吃透，它决定了方法是否成立。
2) 直接跳到方法部分看 NaRA 的参数化：ΔW(t)=B·C(t)·A 的设计、超网络输入是什么（噪声标量/时间步嵌入）、输出如何约束尺度与稳定性。
3) 看与 Multi-LoRA 的对比与消融（文中提到 Section 6.5）：重点确认分段训练为何反而更差（优化不稳？数据/噪声段不均衡？共享不足？）。
4) 看“噪声-更新幅度相关性”的分析图：它是证明“确实在学噪声动态”而不是单纯增加参数的关键证据。
如果你关心 pretrain 侧启示：把它当作一个案例，思考 diffusion LM 的训练目标是否也应做噪声分段加权、或在高噪声段引入不同的预测头/损失形态。

summary_en.core_problem: How to do parameter-efficient adaptation for diffusion LLMs across the denoising trajectory: vanilla LoRA uses a single, noise-agnostic low-rank update for all timesteps, which empirically under-adapts high-noise regimes and limits downstream gains.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a PEFT/interface paper for diffusion LMs rather than a pretraining recipe paper, but it carries a clear message for foundation-model training: diffusion LMs exhibit strong distribution/learning-difficulty shifts across noise levels, so static adapters (and potentially static training weights) can be systematically mismatched. For teams working on diffusion/any-order LMs, it provides a practical, low-overhead way to condition adaptation on timestep without maintaining separate adapters per noise bucket.
summary_en.technical_approach: NaRA replaces LoRA’s fixed update ΔW=BA with a decomposed, timestep-conditioned form ΔW(t)=B·C(t)·A. The side projections A and B are learned and shared across all noise levels, while the low-rank core C(t) is generated by a lightweight globally shared hypernetwork conditioned on the noise level/timestep embedding. This yields a continuous family of updates over t, capturing cross-timestep structure while still allowing distinct behaviors at different noise regimes. The paper also argues (theoretically) that multiple distinct update matrices can be represented within this decomposition, addressing concerns that sharing A/B might overly constrain expressivity. A naive alternative—training separate LoRA adapters for different timestep intervals (Multi-LoRA)—is discussed as parameter-inefficient and empirically weaker, likely due to fragmented sharing and harder optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on the LLaDA family (Base and Instruct) and span commonsense reasoning, math reasoning, and code generation. A key diagnostic result (Figure 1) shows vanilla LoRA reduces cross-entropy mainly in low-to-mid noise regimes but yields negligible improvement at high noise, motivating noise-aware adaptation. NaRA is reported to consistently outperform LoRA and other noise-agnostic PEFT baselines with negligible overhead, and analysis indicates the hypernetwork modulates update magnitude in correlation with noise level—evidence that the method is actually leveraging diffusion dynamics. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables with exact deltas (task scores, ranks, parameter counts), so validating the magnitude and consistency of gains requires checking the result and ablation sections directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the motivation + Figure 1 to internalize the failure mode of static LoRA at high noise.
- Read the method section focusing on the parameterization ΔW(t)=B·C(t)·A and what the hypernetwork takes as input/produces as output.
- Jump to the comparison against Multi-LoRA (mentioned around Section 6.5) to understand why bucketed adapters underperform despite more parameters.
- Check the analysis plots showing how C(t) (or update norms) vary with noise; this is the strongest evidence that the approach is not just “more parameters”.

recommendation.zh: dLLM 的 LoRA 不该按 AR 经验照搬；先看噪声条件超网设计，值得在内部 dLLM 微调上复现。
recommendation.en: Do not blindly port AR LoRA to dLLMs; the noise-conditioned hypernetwork is the part worth reproducing in internal dLLM tuning.

paper.title: PEFT-Arena: Understanding Parameter-Efficient Finetuning from a Stability-Plasticity Perspective
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) has become the standard approach for adapting large language models, yet evaluations largely emphasize downstream accuracy while overlooking the retention of pretrained capabilities. We argue that PEFT should be assessed through the stability-plasticity dilemma: the trade-off between target-task adaptation and resistance to forgetting. We introduce PEFT-Arena, a benchmark that jointly measures downstream performance and general capability retention. Across m

summary.core_problem: 解决 PEFT 评估长期只看目标任务精度、忽略预训练能力保留的问题，试图用 stability-plasticity 框架统一衡量适应与遗忘。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测与分析工作。对基座研究员的价值在于，它把后训练方法的比较从“谁在下游分数高”转成“谁更少破坏预训练表征”。如果这个评测设置做得干净，它能帮助判断哪些 PEFT 参数化更适合作为 continual adaptation 或低成本 post-train 接口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PEFT-Arena，联合评估两件事：目标任务适应能力和通用能力保留。除 benchmark 本身外，还从两个几何视角解释不同 PEFT 方法的差异：在权重空间做谱分析，考察更新如何与预训练权重的奇异值结构相互作用；在激活空间定义 retention 指标，测量微调后通用能力表征是被保留还是被扭曲。论文声称在相近参数预算下，orthogonal finetuning 处在更好的 Pareto 前沿。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模和任务数量，但实验框架显然覆盖多种 PEFT 方法，并在相同参数预算下比较稳定性-可塑性权衡。主要结论是不同方法存在明显 profile 差异，orthogonal finetuning 在保留能力与任务适应之间更均衡。由于缺少具体数值和模型族信息，这篇更适合先看 benchmark 设计、保留指标定义和几何分析部分。
summary.authors_note: Bernhard Schölkopf 是机器学习理论与表示学习领域的知名学者；其参与提高了这篇分析工作的可信度。其余作者机构信息仅从摘要无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fact that PEFT is usually evaluated only by downstream accuracy, while forgetting of pretrained capabilities is largely ignored, and reframes the problem through the stability-plasticity trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and analysis paper. Its value for foundation-model researchers is that it shifts PEFT comparison from task score alone to how much pretrained representations are preserved. If the setup is clean, it can inform which PEFT parameterizations are better interfaces for continual adaptation or low-cost post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PEFT-Arena, a benchmark that jointly measures target-task adaptation and retention of general capabilities. Beyond the benchmark, it analyzes PEFT methods from two geometric views: spectral analysis in weight space to study how updates interact with the pretrained singular-value structure, and retention metrics in activation space to quantify whether finetuning preserves or distorts general-capability representations. Under matched parameter budgets, orthogonal finetuning is reported to achieve the best Pareto frontier.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or the exact task suite, but the setup compares multiple PEFT methods under comparable parameter budgets and evaluates their stability-plasticity profiles. The main empirical claim is that orthogonal finetuning offers a better balance between adaptation and retention. Given the missing numeric details, the benchmark design, retention metrics, and geometric analysis are the parts worth reading first.
summary_en.authors_note: Bernhard Schölkopf is a well-known researcher in machine learning theory and representation learning, which adds credibility to the analysis angle. The affiliations of the other authors cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 post-train 会不会破坏 pretrain 表征，这篇值得看 benchmark 设计和几何分析；结论未必普适，但“保留能力”这个评测轴应该补进内部流程。
recommendation.en: Read it for the benchmark design and geometric analysis if you care whether post-training damages pretrained representations; the headline may not generalize, but the retention axis should be added to internal evals.

paper.title: RotMoLE: Enhancing Mixture of Low-Rank Experts through Rotational Gating Mechanism
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly fine-tuned to handle domain-specific tasks before being applied to vertical applications, adapting them to complex scenarios with diverse specialized knowledge remains challenging. Meanwhile, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has risen as a crucial paradigm for training LLMs, and some recent works have also incorporated MoE into Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to propose the Mixture of Low-rank Experts (MoE-LoRA), to enhance the power of

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 MoE-LoRA 里 gate 的表达能力过弱。传统 MoE 或 MoE-LoRA 的 router 只给每个专家一个标量权重，能做的是“放大或缩小某个专家的贡献”，但不能改变专家输出在表示空间中的方向。作者认为这会限制低秩专家的组合能力，尤其是在专家数有限、任务分布复杂的场景里，模型只能决定用多少专家，不能决定如何重组专家的低秩子空间。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性不高，因为它主要是 PEFT 方向，不是预训练 recipe 或基础建模范式创新。但它有一个值得记住的点：低秩结构不仅能省参数，也给更丰富的 gating 形式留下了空间。作者利用 LoRA 的 rank-r 子空间，把原本在 d 维空间里代价很高的通用线性变换，压缩成在 r 维子空间里做可控旋转。这种思路对 MoE 设计有启发，尤其是当人们讨论 expert aggregation 是否只能是 scalar mixture 时，它提供了一个更细粒度但仍然便宜的替代方案。
summary.technical_approach:
标准 MoE-LoRA 的形式是 W = W0 + Σ g_i B_i A_i，其中 A_i 把 d 维输入投到 r 维低秩空间，B_i 再映回 d 维。作者指出，如果只用标量 g_i，那么每个专家贡献的方向由 B_i A_i 固定，router 只能调节幅度。一个自然想法是给每个专家加一个 r×r 变换 G_i，写成 W = W0 + Σ B_i G_i A_i，这样就能在低秩子空间里做更丰富的变换；但若直接学习一般线性变换，参数和计算仍然偏大。

RotMoLE 的关键设计是把 G_i 限制为 rotation-like 变换。对于 rank=2 的情形，直接用一个角度 θ_i 构造二维旋转矩阵；对于 r>2，作者再引入少量参数来指定一个临时旋转平面，然后在该平面内做旋转，得到对应的 r×r 旋转矩阵 R_i。最终形式是 W = W0 + Σ g_i B_i R_i A_i。这样每个专家除了标量 gate 之外，还有一个“方向调整”自由度，但额外参数量仍然很小：rank=2 时只需 dn 级别，r>2 时是 (d+r)n，而不是为每个专家显式学习完整的 r×r 或更高维变换。这个设计的核心不是数学上把旋转写出来，而是利用低秩瓶颈把复杂 gating 约束成一个足够便宜、又比 scalar gate 更有表达力的操作。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点是验证 RotMoLE 相比传统 MoE-LoRA 在复杂场景下是否更有效，尤其是多任务、多领域或多语言这类需要专家重组能力的设定。作者反复强调 candidate experts 有限时，旋转 gate 的收益更明显，因为它扩大了固定专家集合可张成的解空间。题面没有给出具体表格数字，但从论文结构和引言表述看，实验应包含：与 LoRA、MoE-LoRA 及不同 gating 变体的主结果对比；不同 rank、expert 数、top-k 设置下的消融；以及参数量与性能的权衡。若只看结论，RotMoLE 的卖点不是增加很多参数后换来提升，而是在很小额外开销下，让低秩专家组合更灵活。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 里对 scalar gating 局限的论证，再看方法部分关于为什么把一般线性变换约束成 rotation。真正需要判断的是：这个约束是否合理，是否比直接增大 expert 数或 rank 更划算。阅读时重点看三处：1）参数复杂度推导，确认额外开销确实低；2）r=2 与 r>2 两种构造的差别；3）消融里 rotation gate 的独立贡献，而不是把收益混在更多参数或更复杂训练技巧里。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。如果关心 MoE/LoRA 结构设计，可以再细看不同任务设置下收益是否稳定，以及当 expert 数足够大时旋转机制是否仍有边际价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific limitation in MoE-LoRA: the router usually assigns only scalar weights to selected experts. That means it can scale each expert’s contribution, but it cannot change the direction of the expert output in representation space. The authors argue that this is too restrictive when a small set of low-rank experts must cover diverse tasks or domains.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it is mainly a PEFT architecture tweak. Still, it contains one useful idea for model design: low-rank structure does not only reduce parameters, it also creates a cheap subspace where richer expert transformations become feasible. Instead of treating expert aggregation as scalar mixing only, the paper shows how to add a directional transformation inside the LoRA subspace at modest cost. That is a relevant design pattern for sparse adaptation and possibly for future MoE variants.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Standard MoE-LoRA writes the adapted weight as W = W0 + Σ g_i B_i A_i, where A_i projects from d dimensions to rank r and B_i maps back. With scalar gates g_i, the router controls magnitude but not orientation; the spatial contribution of each expert is fixed by B_i A_i. A more expressive alternative would be W = W0 + Σ B_i G_i A_i with an r×r transformation G_i per expert, but a fully general G_i is still relatively expensive.

RotMoLE constrains G_i to be a rotation-style transform. For rank 2, a single angle θ_i defines a 2D rotation matrix directly. For r > 2, the method uses a small number of extra parameters to define a temporary rotation plane for each expert, then constructs an r×r rotation matrix R_i within that plane. The final form becomes W = W0 + Σ g_i B_i R_i A_i. The point is to add directional flexibility without paying for a full unconstrained transformation. The extra parameter count stays small: on the order of dn for rank 2 and (d+r)n for higher ranks, rather than learning large dense transforms for each expert.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to show that RotMoLE improves over standard MoE-LoRA in settings where expert composition matters, such as multi-task, multilingual, or otherwise heterogeneous adaptation scenarios. The claimed advantage is strongest when the number of candidate experts is limited, because rotational gating enlarges the effective solution space spanned by a fixed expert set. The prompt does not include the full result tables, but the paper appears to compare against LoRA, MoE-LoRA, and alternative gating variants, with ablations over rank, number of experts, and top-k routing. The main empirical claim is efficiency of expressiveness: better expert recombination with only a small parameter overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the motivation for why scalar gating is insufficient, then move to the method section where the authors justify using rotations instead of general linear transforms. The key question is whether the added structure is a good trade-off compared with simply increasing rank or adding more experts. Focus on three parts: the parameter/computation analysis, the difference between the rank-2 and rank>2 constructions, and the ablations isolating the effect of the rotation gate from other changes. A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read more closely only if you are actively working on MoE/LoRA design.

recommendation.zh: MoE-LoRA 的旋转门控可作适配器路由备查；不是预训练 MoE 证据，先看门控参数化和消融即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as an adapter-routing reference; not evidence for pretraining MoE, so read the gate parameterization and ablations only.

paper.title: HELLoRA: Hot Experts Layer-Level Low-Rank Adaptation for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) dominates parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, yet most variants target dense architectures. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale parameters at near-constant per-token compute, and their sparse activation patterns create untapped opportunities for more efficient adaptation. We propose Hot-Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation (HELLoRA), which attaches LoRA modules only to the most frequently activated experts at each layer. This simple mechanism

summary.core_problem: 现有LoRA等参数高效微调方法直接应用于MoE模型时，会给所有专家都添加适配器，造成参数和计算浪费，还可能破坏预训练阶段学习到的专家专业化特性，引入噪声梯度。
summary.importance: 利用MoE模型的稀疏激活特性设计适配的高效微调方案，同时实现参数效率、计算效率和下游性能提升，为大参数量MoE模型的低成本下游适配提供了实用方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HELLoRA层级热专家低秩适配方法，首先用10%左右的目标任务数据做轻量warm-up，统计每个MoE层中各专家的激活频率，仅选择激活频率最高的top-k热专家添加LoRA适配器，冷专家保持冻结；还可结合LoRI方法进一步冻结LoRA的A矩阵，仅更新热专家适配器B矩阵的10%参数，进一步压缩参数预算。
summary.experiments: 在OlMoE-1B-7B、Mixtral-8×7B、DeepSeekMoE三个MoE backbone，数学推理、代码生成、安全对齐三类任务上测试，HELLoRA在参数数量、适配器FLOPs、训练吞吐量均优于标准LoRA、DoRA、LoRI、LoRAMoE等基线，同时下游任务表现更优，即使随机选择专家适配也略优于全专家LoRA。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的MoE专家激活偏斜现象观察、方法部分的HELLoRA两阶段流程、表4的消融实验结果；预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA are directly applied to MoE models, adapters are added to all experts, resulting in parameter and computation waste, and may also damage the expert specialization learned in the pre-training stage, introducing noisy gradients.
summary_en.importance: It designs an adapted efficient fine-tuning scheme leveraging the sparse activation property of MoE models, achieving simultaneous improvement in parameter efficiency, computation efficiency and downstream performance, and provides a practical solution for low-cost downstream adaptation of large-parameter MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: HELLoRA (Hot Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation) is proposed. First, a lightweight warm-up is performed with about 10% of the target task data to count the activation frequency of each expert in each MoE layer. LoRA adapters are only added to the top-k hot experts with the highest activation frequency, and cold experts remain frozen. It can also be combined with the LoRI method to further freeze the A matrix of LoRA and only update 10% of the parameters of the B matrix in hot expert adapters to further reduce the parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three MoE backbones (OlMoE-1B-7B, Mixtral-8×7B, DeepSeekMoE) and three task families (math reasoning, code generation, safety alignment), HELLoRA outperforms baselines including standard LoRA, DoRA, LoRI, LoRAMoE in parameter count, adapter FLOPs and training throughput, while achieving better downstream task performance. Even random expert selection slightly outperforms full-expert LoRA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the observation of skewed expert activation in MoE models in the introduction, the two-stage pipeline of HELLoRA in the method section, and the ablation results in Table 4; estimated reading time 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 利用 MoE 路由倾斜特性的 PEFT 方法，'只微调热点专家' 的思路很直觉，可作为 MoE post-training 的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: A PEFT method exploiting MoE routing skewness; the idea of 'only fine-tuning hot experts' is intuitive and serves as a good baseline reference for MoE post-training.
