paper.title: Learning When to Adapt
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, yet its learned correction is static: the same low-rank update is applied to every input. This input-agnostic approach creates an inevitable compromise between adapting to the fine-tuning distribution and preserving pre-trained behavior on inputs outside that distribution, contributing to catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DISeL (Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA), which augments LoRA modules with lightweight input

summary.core_problem: LoRA等参数高效微调方法的核心缺陷是其学习到的修正为输入无关（input-agnostic）：相同的低秩更新被应用于所有输入，导致在微调域适配和预训练行为保留之间存在不可避免的折衷，是灾难性遗忘的重要成因。
summary.importance: 提出了一种减轻微调灾难性遗忘的实用方案，通过输入依赖的门控机制实现选择性激活，在不显著增加参数和计算开销的前提下改善了适配与保留的权衡。该方法还能通过门控激活模式揭示任务特定知识在网络中的层间定位，对理解LLM微调动态有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: DISeL（Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA）在LoRA的每个秩一分量上增加了一个轻量级的输入依赖门控，输出范围在[0,1]之间。门控初始化为接近零，意味着训练从预训练模型行为开始，仅在能降低微调损失时才被激活。每个秩一分量独立门控，相比Mixture-of-LoRA方法（路由整个LoRA模块）更精细。与Gated LoRA（针对多任务间干扰）不同，DISeL的设计目标明确指向保留预训练域行为，通过使适配器在微调分布外输入上处于非活跃状态来减少遗忘。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Mistral系列模型上针对数学推理和代码生成任务进行了评测。DISeL相比LoRA及其变体（如DoRA、AdaLoRA）持续降低了灾难性遗忘程度，同时保持了与之相当的域内精度。门控激活模式分析显示了不同层在微调过程中的参与程度差异，提供了任务特定知识定位的直接洞察。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第2章的线性回归最小模型分析（清晰展示了输入无关更新为何必然导致适配-保留折衷）、第3章的门控机制设计（初始化策略和前向传播方式）、以及第5章的门控激活可视化（层间定位分析）。预计阅读时间30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A core limitation of LoRA and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods is that their learned corrections are input-agnostic: the same low-rank update is applied to every input, creating an inherent trade-off between adaptation to the fine-tuning distribution and preservation of pre-trained behavior on out-of-distribution inputs—a major contributor to catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Presents a practical approach to mitigating catastrophic forgetting in fine-tuning. The input-dependent gating mechanism enables selective activation, improving the adaptation-retention trade-off without significant parameter or compute overhead. The gate activation patterns also provide a window into the layer-wise localization of task-specific knowledge, offering insights into LLM fine-tuning dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: DISeL (Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA) augments each rank-one component of LoRA with a lightweight input-dependent gate whose output lies in [0,1]. Gates are initialized close to zero, so training begins with the pre-trained model's behavior intact, and gates activate only when doing so reduces the fine-tuning loss. Each rank-one component is independently gated, offering finer granularity than mixture-of-LoRA approaches that route entire modules. Unlike Gated LoRA which targets inter-task interference in multi-task fine-tuning, DISeL explicitly aims to preserve pre-training-domain behavior by rendering the adapter inactive on inputs outside the fine-tuning distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama and Mistral models fine-tuned for mathematical reasoning and code generation. DISeL consistently reduces catastrophic forgetting compared to LoRA variants (DoRA, AdaLoRA) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Gate activation analysis reveals differential layer participation during fine-tuning, providing direct insight into task-specific knowledge localization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guidance: Focus on Section 2's minimal linear regression model analysis (cleanly demonstrates why input-agnostic updates force an adaptation-retention trade-off), Section 3's gating mechanism design (initialization strategy and forward propagation), and Section 5's gate activation visualization (layer localization analysis). Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看门控设计和遗忘评测；若 OOD 保留集设置干净，这个动态 LoRA 是 continual post-train 的可复现 baseline。
recommendation.en: Read the gating design and forgetting evaluation; if the OOD retention sets are clean, DISeL is a useful baseline for continual post-training.

paper.title: LoCO: Low-rank Compositional Rotation Fine-tuning
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an critical technique for adapting large-scale foundation models across natural language processing and computer vision. While existing methods such as low-rank adaptations achieve parameter efficiency via low-rank weight updates, they are limited in their ability to preserve the geometric structure of pretrained representations. We introduce Low-rank Compositional Orthogonal fine-tuning (LoCO), a novel PEFT method that constructs orthogonal

summary.core_problem: 提出一种保持预训练表示几何结构的参数高效微调方法，缓解普通低秩增量更新可能破坏表示空间的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 PEFT 方法创新：用低秩 skew-symmetric 矩阵构造近似正交旋转，把适配过程约束为组合旋转而不是任意权重增量；对 LLM 后训练和 foundation model adaptation 有参考价值，但不是预训练范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: LoCO 通过低秩 skew-symmetric matrices 生成正交变换，并把多个旋转组成 compositional rotation chains；同时提出近似方案，使组合旋转可以并行计算，从而适配高维特征空间，并控制正交性近似误差和计算复杂度。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 diffusion transformer fine-tuning、vision transformer adaptation 等多个领域验证 LoCO；但提供信息未列出具体 LLM 参数规模、训练数据规模、基线集合或提升幅度，需读实验表确认是否只是 PEFT 变体的常规增益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that preserves the geometry of pretrained representations, addressing the risk that standard low-rank updates distort the feature space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a PEFT method: it constrains adaptation to low-rank compositional orthogonal rotations rather than arbitrary weight deltas. This is relevant to post-training and foundation-model adaptation, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoCO constructs orthogonal transformations from low-rank skew-symmetric matrices and composes them into rotation chains. It introduces an approximation that enables parallel computation of the composed rotations in high-dimensional feature spaces while controlling approximation error and compute cost.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports validation on diffusion transformer fine-tuning, vision transformer adaptation, and other domains, but does not specify LLM scale, dataset scale, baseline coverage, or numerical gains; the experimental tables are needed to judge whether the gains are beyond a standard PEFT variant.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Korea University, KAIST, and INEEJI.

recommendation.zh: PEFT 几何约束思路值得扫 §3；若无大模型语言实验，只能当 LoRA 族变体备查。
recommendation.en: Skim §3 for the geometric PEFT constraint; without large language-model experiments, treat it as a LoRA-family variant reference.

paper.title: PreFT: Prefill-only finetuning for efficient inference
paper.abstract: Large language models can now be personalised efficiently at scale using parameter efficient finetuning methods (PEFTs), but serving user-specific PEFTs harms throughput, even with specialised kernels and memory management techniques. This is because, theoretically and empirically, a mismatch exists between prefill (processing a large number of tokens at once) and decode (generating a single token autoregressively): the latter has far lower throughput when serving multiple adapters. Rather than

summary.core_problem: 多用户个性化场景下，批量服务多个PEFT适配器时，解码阶段的内存开销会大幅降低推理吞吐量，现有定制内核、内存调度等优化方式无法彻底解决该问题。
summary.importance: 从PEFT设计的源头适配推理效率需求，而非在现有架构上做增量优化，为多租户LLM服务的PEFT设计提供了新的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Prefill-only Finetuning（PreFT），仅在预填充阶段激活PEFT适配器，解码阶段完全丢弃适配器。分别实现了基于LoRA和ReFT的PreFT变体，适配vLLM推理引擎和trl训练库。该方法利用预填充阶段为计算绑定、适配器加载不会降低利用率的特性，避开了解码阶段内存绑定、多适配器开销大的痛点。
summary.experiments: 在4张H100上部署Llama 3.1 70B、服务最多512个适配器时，无需定制内核，预填充-only ReFT的吞吐量是多LoRA服务的1.9倍，预填充-only LoRA达到1.87倍；在更小参数量模型上增益更高，Llama 3.1 8B上分别达到2.21倍和1.83倍。下游任务上，PreFT在SFT场景的精度和全位置PEFT无统计显著差异，RL场景的数学推理、代码生成性能接近全位置PEFT，长文本生成的长度控制能力和传统LoRA相当。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的动机分析、第3章的PreFT方法定义、第4~5章的核心实验结果即可，预计阅读时间15分钟，不需要深入看内核实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-user personalization scenarios, serving multiple PEFT adapters in batch incurs high memory overhead during the decode phase, which significantly reduces inference throughput. Existing optimizations including custom kernels and memory scheduling cannot fully resolve this issue.
summary_en.importance: PreFT adapts PEFT design to inference efficiency requirements from the source, instead of making incremental optimizations on existing architectures, providing a new optimization direction for PEFT design in multi-tenant LLM serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: PreFT (Prefill-only Finetuning) only activates PEFT adapters during the prefill phase, and discards adapters completely during the decode phase. PreFT variants based on LoRA and ReFT are implemented, compatible with the vLLM inference engine and trl training library. It leverages the characteristic that the prefill phase is compute-bound and adapter loading does not reduce utilization, avoiding the pain point that the decode phase is memory-bound and suffers from high multi-adapter overhead.
summary_en.experiments: When serving up to 512 adapters on Llama 3.1 70B with 4 H100s, without custom kernels, prefill-only ReFT achieves 1.9x throughput of multi-LoRA serving, and prefill-only LoRA reaches 1.87x. Gains are higher on smaller models: 2.21x and 1.83x respectively on Llama 3.1 8B. On downstream tasks, PreFT has no statistically significant accuracy difference from full-position PEFT in SFT scenarios, performs close to full-position PEFT on mathematical reasoning and code generation in RL scenarios, and has equivalent length control ability as traditional LoRA for long-form generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the motivation analysis in Chapter 1, PreFT method definition in Chapter 3, and core experimental results in Chapters 4-5. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. No need to dive into kernel implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统分析和消融即可；它不会改变预训练方法，但会改变你评估 PEFT 个性化是否可部署的标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the systems analysis and ablations; it does not change pretraining, but it changes how deployable PEFT personalization should be judged.

paper.title: GPart: End-to-End Isometric Fine-Tuning via Global Parameter Partitioning
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of large language models (LLMs). However, its bilinear structure introduces a critical limitation: the mapping from trainable parameters to weight updates is not distance-preserving, distorting the optimization landscape. Methods that project a low-dimensional vector into LoRA's parameter space, such as Uni-LoRA, improve parameter efficiency, but the subsequent bilinear LoRA map breaks end-to-e

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个比常见 PEFT 论文更底层的问题：LoRA 之所以高效，不只是因为参数少，也因为它把优化限制在低秩子空间里；但这个低秩双线性参数化会扭曲训练坐标与真实权重更新之间的几何关系。换句话说，优化器看到的是 A、B 因子空间里的欧氏距离，而真正作用在模型上的更新是 BA，这个映射不是等距的。GPart 要解决的就是这个 end-to-end geometry mismatch：在同样极低参数预算下，能否直接在全权重空间中定义一个随机低维子空间，并保持从可训练向量到权重更新的整体等距映射，从而去掉 LoRA 的低秩瓶颈和几何失真。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的价值不在于它会替代全量训练，而在于它把一个常被忽略的问题讲清楚了：参数高效微调不仅是“更新多少参数”，也是“用什么坐标系更新”。LoRA 的成功让很多人默认低秩结构本身就是合理归纳偏置，但 GPart 提醒我们，低秩并不只是压缩，还会改变优化几何。这个视角和 intrinsic dimension、随机子空间训练、continual adaptation 都有直接关系。若一个简单的全局随机分组映射，在极低预算下能稳定接近甚至超过 LoRA/Uni-LoRA，说明下游适配所需的关键未必是低秩结构，而可能只是一个足够合适、几何更干净的低维子空间。对基座训练的启发有两层。第一，后训练接口设计不应只看参数量和吞吐，也要看更新参数化是否与预训练权重空间的局部几何匹配。第二，若随机全局子空间已经足够强，说明预训练模型的可适配性可能高度冗余，这对研究 layerwise plasticity、模块化更新、甚至 mid-training 冷却阶段的可塑性都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它是一个思路清楚、理论动机比经验技巧更扎实的 PEFT 方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: GPart 的核心设计很简单，但背后的取舍很明确。LoRA 对每个权重矩阵 W 用低秩分解 BA 表示更新，因此训练变量在因子空间里，真正更新在权重空间里，中间经过双线性映射。Uni-LoRA 虽然进一步把 trainable state 压成一个 d 维向量，再通过随机 partition matrix 投到 LoRA 参数空间，但最后仍然要经过 BA 这一步，所以 end-to-end 仍不等距。GPart 直接绕开这层结构。作者先把所有需要适配的权重矩阵展平并拼接成一个全局向量，长度为 N。然后定义一个 N×d 的稀疏 partition matrix P，但实现上不显式存矩阵，而是用随机种子生成一个全局置换，再把置换后的 N 个参数位置切成 d 个互不重叠的 group。每个原始参数只属于一个 group，每个 group 共享同一个低维坐标分量，并按 group size 做归一化。这样构造后，P 的列互相正交且单位范数，因此 P^T P = I，d 维训练向量到 N 维权重更新的映射是等距嵌入。直观上看，GPart 相当于在全模型范围内做一次随机 tied update：同组参数接收同一个标量更新，但这种 tying 是全局的，而不是局限在单层或某个低秩因子里。它的几个关键点值得注意。第一，global partition 而不是 per-layer partition，这意味着子空间自由度会自动在全模型范围内分配，而不是人为给每层固定 rank。第二，它没有 LoRA 的 rank 超参数，只有 d 控制子空间维度，模型选择更简单。第三，前向和反向都可以通过 assignment map 高效实现，不需要显式构造大矩阵。和 VeRA 相比，GPart 不是冻结随机基再学缩放，而是直接在全权重空间定义随机子空间；和 intrinsic-dimension 训练相比，它强调存储友好和可复现实现；和 Uni-LoRA 相比，它去掉了最关键的几何扭曲源头，即 LoRA 的双线性回映射。
summary.experiments: 从全文片段可确认的实验结论是：在低参数预算下，GPart 在 encoder 和 decoder 两类模型上都与现有 PEFT 方法竞争，并且在自然语言理解和计算机视觉基准上优于 Uni-LoRA 等方法，在 decoder-only 模型和数学推理任务上保持竞争力。作者显然不是只在单一设置上做验证，而是覆盖了 encoder、decoder、NLP、CV 多个场景，目的是说明“几何更干净的随机子空间”不是某个任务偶然有效。实验上最值得关注的不是绝对分数，而是预算曲线。因为这类方法的核心 claim 是在极低 d 下仍然有效，所以应重点看不同 trainable budget 下，GPart 与 LoRA、VeRA、Uni-LoRA 的性能差距如何变化。若优势主要集中在很低预算区间，说明它确实更适合参数极端受限场景；若预算升高后差距缩小，则符合预期，因为高维时参数化失真影响会减弱。理论部分作者证明了 GPart 的等距性，而实验部分应当配合展示优化更稳定、超参数更少、对 rank 选择不敏感等现象。还应注意两个潜在问题。第一，随机分组是否带来较大 seed variance；如果不同 seed 波动很大，方法的可用性会打折。第二，全局 tied update 是否会伤害需要局部精细适配的任务，尤其是生成式 decoder 上的复杂行为控制。当前片段没有给出具体参数量、模型规模和提升幅度，阅读时需要重点查主表、budget sweep 图和 seed ablation。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合认真看方法和实验，不需要在证明细节上停太久。先看 Introduction，作者把 LoRA、Uni-LoRA、GPart 三种参数化的差别讲得很清楚，尤其是“局部等距”和“端到端等距”的区别。然后看 Method 里全局展平、随机置换、partition matrix 构造这几页，理解为什么 P^T P = I，以及为什么 global partition 比 per-layer partition 更自然。理论部分只要抓住一个结论：GPart 在训练子空间内保持欧氏几何，而 LoRA 的 BA 映射不保持。实验部分优先看不同参数预算下的主结果、与 Uni-LoRA/VeRA/LoRA 的对比、以及 seed 或 group 数 d 的消融。预计 35 到 50 分钟可以读完主要内容。若你关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，这篇最值得深挖的点是：下游适配到底需要结构化低秩先验，还是只需要一个与权重空间几何更一致的低维入口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a deeper issue than standard PEFT efficiency: LoRA is parameter-efficient not only because it trains few parameters, but because it constrains updates to a low-rank bilinear form. That bilinear parameterization distorts geometry. The optimizer moves in factor coordinates A and B, while the actual model update is BA in weight space, and this map is not distance-preserving. GPart asks whether we can keep the trainable budget extremely small while defining the trainable subspace directly in full weight space, so that the mapping from trainable coordinates to weight updates is end-to-end isometric and no longer bottlenecked by low rank.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the main value is conceptual. The paper makes explicit that PEFT is not only about how many parameters are updated, but also about which coordinate system the optimizer sees. LoRA’s empirical success has encouraged the view that low rank is a natural adaptation prior, but GPart shows that low rank also imposes geometric distortion. That connects directly to intrinsic dimension, random subspace training, and continual adaptation. If a simple globally randomized subspace can match or beat LoRA-style methods at very low budgets, then the essential ingredient for adaptation may not be low-rank structure itself, but access to a sufficiently expressive low-dimensional subspace with cleaner geometry. Two implications matter. First, post-training interfaces should be evaluated not only by memory and throughput, but by how well their parameterization aligns with local geometry in pretrained weight space. Second, if random global subspaces already work well, pretrained models may have substantial adaptation redundancy, which is relevant to plasticity analysis, selective updates, and even mid-training or cooldown-stage interventions. In contribution scale, this is a well-motivated PEFT paper with stronger geometric reasoning than most purely empirical tweaks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design is simple and deliberate. In LoRA, each weight update is parameterized as BA, so optimization happens in factor space while the actual update lives in weight space. Uni-LoRA compresses the trainable state further into a d-dimensional vector and maps it into LoRA parameter space with a random partition matrix, but it still ends with the same bilinear BA map, so end-to-end isometry is still broken. GPart removes that intermediate factorization entirely. All adapted weight matrices are flattened and concatenated into a single global vector of length N. The method then defines a sparse N by d partition matrix P, implemented implicitly rather than materialized. A seed-dependent random permutation is applied to the N coordinates, and the permuted coordinates are split into d disjoint groups. Each original parameter belongs to exactly one group, and all parameters in the same group share one trainable scalar, normalized by group size. By construction, the columns of P are orthonormal, so P transpose times P equals the identity. This makes the mapping from the d-dimensional trainable vector to the N-dimensional weight update an isometric embedding. Intuitively, GPart performs a global random tied update across the model: parameters in the same group receive the same scalar update, but the tying is global rather than layer-local or low-rank-factor-specific. Several design choices matter. First, the partition is global rather than per-layer, so the subspace budget is allocated across the whole model instead of forcing a fixed rank per layer. Second, there is no LoRA rank hyperparameter; d alone controls subspace size. Third, both forward and backward passes can be implemented efficiently through the assignment map. Compared with VeRA, GPart does not freeze random bases and learn only scaling vectors; it directly defines a random subspace in full weight space. Compared with intrinsic-dimension training, it is designed to be storage-efficient and practical. Compared with Uni-LoRA, it removes the main source of geometric distortion, namely the bilinear map back to weight space.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the main empirical claim is that GPart is competitive across both encoder and decoder settings, outperforming Uni-LoRA and related PEFT baselines on natural language understanding and computer vision benchmarks at low parameter budgets, while remaining competitive on decoder-only models and mathematical reasoning tasks. The breadth of evaluation matters because the paper is arguing for a parameterization principle, not a task-specific trick. The most important thing to inspect is the budget-performance curve. Since the central claim is about extreme compression, the key question is how GPart compares with LoRA, VeRA, and Uni-LoRA as the trainable dimension d changes. If the gains are concentrated in the very low-budget regime, that would support the geometric argument; if the gap narrows at larger budgets, that would also make sense because parameterization distortion matters less in higher dimensions. The theory section proves isometry, and the experiments should ideally show corresponding practical effects such as more stable optimization, simpler model selection, and reduced sensitivity to rank choices. Two possible weaknesses should be checked carefully. First, random grouping may introduce seed variance; if performance depends heavily on the seed, the method is less attractive in practice. Second, global tied updates may hurt tasks that require fine local adaptation, especially in decoder-only generative settings. The excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, trainable parameter counts, or exact gains, so the main tables, budget sweeps, and seed ablations are the places to verify the strength of the claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: This paper is worth reading more carefully than a typical PEFT tweak, but you do not need to dwell on every proof detail. Start with the introduction, where the distinction between LoRA, Uni-LoRA, and GPart is explained clearly, especially the difference between local isometry and end-to-end isometry. Then read the method section on global flattening, random permutation, and partition-matrix construction. The key point is why P transpose P equals identity and why a global partition is more natural than a per-layer one. In the theory, the main takeaway is enough: GPart preserves Euclidean geometry inside the trainable subspace, while LoRA’s BA map does not. In experiments, prioritize the main results under different trainable budgets, the comparisons against Uni-LoRA, VeRA, and LoRA, and the ablations on seed sensitivity and the choice of d. Around 35 to 50 minutes should be enough to extract the core ideas. From a pretrain-to-posttrain interface perspective, the most interesting question is whether downstream adaptation really needs a structured low-rank prior, or simply a low-dimensional entry point that is geometrically cleaner in weight space.

recommendation.zh: PEFT领域的新范式思路，可关注其等距性设计对微调稳定性的增益，仅阅读方法部分即可
recommendation.en: A new PEFT paradigm with isometric design, check the method section only for insights on fine-tuning stability

paper.title: Rethinking Adapter Placement: A Dominant Adaptation Module Perspective
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that places trainable low-rank adapters into frozen pre-trained models. Recent studies show that using fewer LoRA adapters may still maintain or even improve performance, but existing methods still distribute adapters broadly, leaving where to place a limited number of adapters to maximize performance largely open. To investigate this, we introduce PAGE (Projected Adapter Gradient Energy), a gradient-based sensiti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：如果 LoRA 预算极小，adapter 到底该放在哪一个模块上，而不是沿用“多层、多投影均匀铺开”的默认做法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身不是核心贡献，但对 post-train 与 continual adaptation 有明确启发。它给出一个可操作的 adapter placement 诊断方法：用冻结模型在目标数据上的梯度敏感性来预测 LoRA 初始化时能获得多少训练信号。值得关注的点不是 DomLoRA 省了多少参数，而是论文观察到适配信号高度集中在浅层 FFN down-projection，并且在同一 backbone 上跨任务稳定。这提示不同 Transformer 模块在可适配性上并不均匀，少量模块可能承担了更强的分布迁移入口作用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是 PAGE，即 Projected Adapter Gradient Energy。作者先在未插入 LoRA、未训练的原模型上，对每个候选投影矩阵计算 sample-wise gradient，并用经验 Fisher 形式的平方梯度均值衡量模块敏感性。由于 LoRA 的低秩增量作用在同一个有效权重上，原权重梯度可以近似反映 LoRA 因子初始化时能接收到的梯度能量。第二步是 DomLoRA：只在 PAGE 最高的单个模块上放 LoRA，其余参数全部冻结。论文的主要观察是 PAGE 并不是平滑分布在多层 attention 或 FFN 上，而是集中到一个浅层 FFN down-projection。这个模块的具体层号依赖模型架构，但在同一模型上对 instruction following、数学、代码、多轮对话等任务保持稳定。与 AdaLoRA、DoRA 这类改变 LoRA 参数化或预算分配的方法不同，DomLoRA 主要改变 placement，且可以作为外层策略叠加到这些 LoRA 变体上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-8B 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 两个 8B 级模型，任务包括指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成和多轮对话。核心结果是：DomLoRA 只使用 vanilla LoRA 约 0.7% 的可训练参数，平均表现仍能与 vanilla LoRA 竞争，并在作者报告的平均指标上超过 vanilla LoRA。论文还把同样的单模块 placement 用到 AdaLoRA 和 DoRA 上，报告了平均性能提升。消融的重点是 PAGE 分布与任务稳定性：同一 backbone 的 dominant adaptation module 在不同下游任务上基本一致，而不同模型家族的层位置不同，说明它更像架构和预训练模型共同形成的结构属性，而不是某个任务数据的偶然结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分对 PAGE 的定义，以及 Figure 1 中 adapter placement 三种范式的对比和 PAGE 集中现象。实验部分优先看不同任务、不同 backbone 上 dominant module 是否稳定，以及 DomLoRA 与 vanilla LoRA、AdaLoRA、DoRA 的对比表。若关心 continual pretrain 或低成本领域适配，可以进一步看 sample-wise gradient 与经验 Fisher 的实现细节：它是否依赖 probe set 规模、loss mask、LoRA 初始化方式，以及是否会随训练阶段变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies where to place LoRA adapters when the adapter budget is extremely small, instead of following the common practice of spreading adapters across many layers and projection types.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to post-training and continual adaptation than to foundation pretraining itself. Its useful signal is a practical diagnostic for adapter placement: use gradients on the frozen model to estimate how much training signal a candidate LoRA module will receive at initialization. The notable observation is that this signal concentrates on a shallow FFN down-projection and stays stable across tasks for the same backbone. This suggests that adaptability is not evenly distributed across Transformer modules; a small number of modules may serve as stronger entry points for distributional adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. PAGE, Projected Adapter Gradient Energy, computes sample-wise gradients of each pretrained projection weight on a probe set, then uses an empirical-Fisher-style squared-gradient average as a sensitivity measure. Since a LoRA update modifies the same effective weight through a low-rank perturbation, the gradient of the frozen weight approximates the initial gradient energy available to the LoRA factors. DomLoRA then places a single LoRA adapter on the module with the highest PAGE score and freezes all other parameters. The main finding is that PAGE is not smoothly distributed over attention and FFN projections. It is sharply concentrated on one shallow FFN down-projection. The layer index changes across model families but remains stable across downstream tasks on the same backbone. Unlike AdaLoRA or DoRA, which mainly alter LoRA parameterization or budget allocation, DomLoRA changes placement and can be combined with those variants.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, with tasks covering instruction following, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn dialogue. DomLoRA uses about 0.7% of the trainable parameters of vanilla LoRA, yet remains competitive and is reported to outperform vanilla LoRA on average. The same placement strategy is also applied to AdaLoRA and DoRA, where the paper reports average gains. The most useful ablations concern the PAGE distribution and task stability: the dominant adaptation module is largely unchanged across tasks for a fixed backbone, while its layer index differs across model families. This supports the view that the selected module reflects a property of the architecture and pretrained checkpoint, not just a peculiarity of a downstream dataset.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the PAGE definition and Figure 1, which contrasts broad adapter placement with the single dominant-module pattern. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing DomLoRA with vanilla LoRA, AdaLoRA, and DoRA, and the plots showing task stability of the dominant module. For continual pretraining or low-cost domain adaptation, the implementation details of the gradient probe are worth a closer look, especially probe-set size, loss masking, LoRA initialization, and whether the dominant module changes across training stages.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 PAGE 定义和模块热力图；单浅层 FFN 主导适配若复现，会改变低预算 LoRA 的默认放置策略。
recommendation.en: Read the PAGE definition and module heatmaps; if the shallow-FFN dominance replicates, it changes the default placement strategy for ultra-low-budget LoRA.

paper.title: Benchmarking Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models for Low-Resource Tajik Text Generation with the Tajik Web Corpus
paper.abstract: This paper is devoted to the adaptation of generative large language models for the Tajik language, a low-resource language with Cyrillic script. To overcome the shortage of digital text resources, the author created and publicly released the Tajik Web Corpus, the largest open-access corpus of Tajik, comprising 319,298 documents (~1.11 billion characters). On a subsample of 10,000 documents, 17 configurations were benchmarked, covering autoregressive, encoder-decoder, and encoder-only models wit

summary.core_problem: 为低资源塔吉克语构建开放语料，并比较多种 LLM 参数高效微调策略在塔吉克文本生成上的效果与成本。
summary.importance: 主要贡献是低资源语言数据和 PEFT 基准。Tajik Web Corpus 包含 319,298 篇文档、约 11.1 亿字符，是面向塔吉克语的开放数据资源；实验给出 LoRA、QLoRA 和全量微调在质量、显存和训练时间上的取舍。对多语种预训练的数据覆盖和 tokenizer 问题有旁证价值，但实验规模偏任务适配。
summary.technical_approach: 作者收集并发布 Tajik Web Corpus，并在 10,000 篇文档子集上比较 17 种配置，覆盖自回归、encoder-decoder、encoder-only 模型，以及 full fine-tuning、LoRA、QLoRA rank 8/16 等策略。指标包括 perplexity、cross-entropy、峰值 GPU 显存和训练时间。
summary.experiments: 语料规模为 319,298 篇文档、约 11.1 亿字符；微调实验使用 10,000 篇文档子集。Mistral 7B + QLoRA rank 16 的平均 perplexity 为 5.03，标准差 0.03。rank 8 到 rank 16 的提升统计上不显著，但显存增加。小型 GPT-2 系列中，全量微调得到更低 perplexity，摘要给出 GPT-2 为 3.48。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Kazan Federal University 的 Institute of Computational Mathematics and Information Technologies。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds an open Tajik corpus and benchmarks parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies for Tajik text generation.
summary_en.importance: The main contributions are a low-resource language corpus and a PEFT benchmark. The Tajik Web Corpus contains 319,298 documents and roughly 1.11 billion characters. The experiments compare quality, memory, and training-time trade-offs for LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tuning. This is only indirectly relevant to multilingual pretraining and tokenizer coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author releases the Tajik Web Corpus and evaluates 17 configurations on a 10,000-document subset. The benchmark covers autoregressive, encoder-decoder, and encoder-only models, along with full fine-tuning, LoRA, and QLoRA at ranks 8 and 16. Metrics include perplexity, cross-entropy, peak GPU memory, and training time.
summary_en.experiments: The corpus has 319,298 documents and about 1.11 billion characters; the tuning benchmark uses a 10,000-document subset. Mistral 7B with QLoRA rank 16 obtains mean perplexity 5.03 with standard deviation 0.03. Increasing rank from 8 to 16 gives statistically insignificant improvement while increasing memory use. For small GPT-2 models, full fine-tuning yields lower perplexity, with GPT-2 reported at 3.48.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with the Institute of Computational Mathematics and Information Technologies, Kazan Federal University.

recommendation.zh: 低资源语料可登记；实验只看 rank/显存取舍，别把 1 万文档 PEFT 结论外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Register the corpus; only skim the rank-memory trade-off, and do not extrapolate a 10k-document PEFT result to pretraining.

paper.title: Compress Then Adapt? No, Do It Together via Task-aware Union of Subspaces
paper.abstract: Adapting large pretrained models to diverse tasks is now routine, yet the two dominant strategies of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and low-rank compression are typically composed in sequence. This decoupled practice first compresses and then fine-tunes adapters, potentially misaligning the compressed subspace with downstream objectives and squandering a global parameter budget. To overcome this limitation, we introduce JACTUS (Joint Adaptation and Compression with a Task-aware Union of

summary.core_problem: 解决现有低秩压缩和参数高效微调串行执行导致压缩子空间与下游任务目标错位、浪费参数预算的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一压缩与适配的联合框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出JACTUS框架，从校准集估计输入与梯度协方差，构造与预训练权重子空间的正交并集，在并集内做投影低秩近似，按参数边际增益全局分配秩，仅训练紧凑核心矩阵。
summary.experiments: 在多下游任务上相比串行压缩+微调方法参数效率提升30%左右，性能损失小于1%。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括新加坡国立大学、南开大学、A*STAR I2R。

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problem that sequential execution of low-rank compression and parameter-efficient fine-tuning leads to misalignment between compressed subspace and downstream objectives, wasting parameter budget.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, propose a unified framework for joint compression and adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose JACTUS framework, estimate input and gradient covariance from calibration set, form orthogonal union with pretrained weight subspace, perform projected low-rank approximation inside the union, allocate rank globally by marginal gain per parameter, only train compact core matrix.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with sequential compression + fine-tuning methods, parameter efficiency improves by about 30% on multiple downstream tasks, performance loss is less than 1%.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include National University of Singapore, Nankai University, A*STAR I2R.

recommendation.zh: 压缩与PEFT联合优化的增量工作，仅看摘要和核心公式即可，不需要复现。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on joint compression and PEFT, only read abstract and core formulas, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods face a tradeoff between adapter size and expressivity: ultra-low-parameter adapters are confined to fixed low-rank subspaces, capping performance even with extended training. We propose BoostLoRA, a gradient-boosting framework that overcomes this limit by iteratively training and merging minimal adapters on the examples the current model gets wrong. A ROTATE SVD basis strategy assigns each round to an orthogonal subspace, so cumulative effective ran

summary.core_problem: 如何在保持极低参数量（ultra-low-rank）的同时，提升 PEFT（参数高效微调）方法的表达能力，打破 adapter size 和性能之间的 trade-off？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于梯度提升（gradient-boosting）的 PEFT 框架，通过迭代训练和合并极低秩 adapter，实现了有效秩的线性增长而无推理开销，为资源受限下的高效微调提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BoostLoRA 框架：1) 迭代训练极小 adapter，专门拟合当前模型预测错误的样本（类似 boosting）；2) 采用 ROTATE SVD 基策略，将每轮训练分配到正交子空间，确保累积有效秩随轮数线性增长；3) 训练后合并 adapter 并丢弃，实现零推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，BoostLoRA 在 GSM8K (89.1%) 和 MATH-500 (68.8%) 上超越了最佳单次极低参 adapter (TinyLoRA) 和全量微调；在代码生成任务 (MBPP 57.2%, HumanEval 80.4%) 上也表现优异，且展示了跨架构迁移能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the expressivity of PEFT methods while maintaining ultra-low parameter counts, breaking the trade-off between adapter size and performance?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a gradient-boosting-based PEFT framework that achieves linear growth in effective rank without inference overhead by iteratively training and merging ultra-low-rank adapters, offering a new approach for efficient fine-tuning under resource constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces BoostLoRA: 1) iteratively trains minimal adapters focusing on examples the current model gets wrong (boosting); 2) uses a ROTATE SVD basis strategy to assign each round to an orthogonal subspace, ensuring cumulative effective rank grows linearly; 3) merges and discards adapters post-training for zero inference overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen2.5-3B, BoostLoRA achieves 89.1% on GSM8K and 68.8% on MATH-500, surpassing the best single-shot ultra-low parameter adapter (TinyLoRA) and full fine-tuning. It also excels in code generation (MBPP 57.2%, HumanEval 80.4%) and demonstrates cross-architecture transfer.

recommendation.zh: 将 boosting 思想引入 LoRA 训练，通过正交子空间迭代累积有效秩，思路有趣但主要针对极低资源微调，作为 PEFT 变体备查。
recommendation.en: Introduces boosting to LoRA training, accumulating effective rank iteratively via orthogonal subspaces; an interesting PEFT variant for ultra-low resource settings, good to know as literature.

paper.title: Leveraging LLMs for Multi-File DSL Code Generation: An Industrial Case Study
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on general-purpose code generation, yet their applicability to enterprise domain-specific languages (DSLs) remains underexplored, especially for repository-scale change generation spanning multiple files and folder structures from a single natural-language (NL) instruction. We report an industrial case study at BMW that adapts code-oriented LLMs to generate and modify project-root DSL artifacts for an Xtext-based DSL that drives downstream Java/TypeS

summary.core_problem: 评估并适配代码 LLM 以完成企业 DSL 的多文件、仓库级代码生成与修改。
summary.importance: 这是工业代码生成案例研究，不是基座模型方法论文；但它涉及 repository-scale 表示、跨文件依赖建模和小模型适配，对代码模型数据组织与评测设计有一点实务参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建端到端流程：从企业 DSL 项目中制作数据集，把文件夹层级编码成保留路径信息的 JSON，使模型能在单次响应中生成整个项目根目录下的多文件工件；然后比较 baseline prompting、one-shot ICL 与参数高效微调在 Qwen2.5-Coder/DeepSeek-Coder 7B 上的表现。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是两个 7B instruction-tuned code LLM，任务为 Xtext-based DSL 的仓库级生成与修改。摘要未给出明确提升幅度或强基线，只能判断其价值主要在工业任务定义和数据表示，而非方法突破。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Technical University of Munich 与 BMW Group 的工业案例研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to adapt code LLMs for repository-scale, multi-file generation and editing in an enterprise domain-specific language.
summary_en.importance: This is an industrial code-generation case study rather than a foundation-model methods paper, but it offers some practical signal on repository-scale representations, cross-file dependency handling, and evaluation design for code models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an end-to-end pipeline: dataset construction from enterprise DSL projects, path-preserving JSON serialization of folder hierarchies so the model can emit multi-file artifacts in one response, and comparison of baseline prompting, one-shot ICL, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning on Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder 7B.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use two 7B instruction-tuned code LLMs on Xtext-based DSL generation and modification tasks. The abstract does not provide clear effect sizes or strong baselines, so the main value appears to be in task formulation and data representation rather than a methodological advance.
summary_en.authors_note: An industrial case study from Technical University of Munich and BMW Group.

recommendation.zh: 典型工业 case study，方法新意有限；若你关心代码数据如何序列化成仓库级训练样本，只看 JSON 表示和评测设定。
recommendation.en: A standard industrial case study with limited novelty; only read the data serialization and evaluation setup if you care about repo-scale code training examples.

paper.title: Low-Rank Adaptation Redux for Large Models
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the de facto standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of foundation models, enabling the adaptation of billion-parameter networks with minimal computational and memory overhead. Despite its empirical success and rapid proliferation of variants, it remains elusive which architectural choices, optimization techniques, and deployment constraints should guide practical method selection. This overview revisits LoRA through the lens of signal proces

summary.core_problem: 梳理 LoRA 及其变体在大模型参数高效微调中的设计选择、优化机制和部署约束，解释为什么这些方法有效。
summary.importance: 这是综述/观点型工作，不提出新的预训练方法，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有一定参考价值，尤其是理解低秩更新、内存瓶颈和适配器设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: 从信号处理视角重述 LoRA，将现有方法按架构设计、效率与系统约束、理论机制等轴线组织，试图用经典低秩建模与逆问题工具解释现代 PEFT 方案。
summary.experiments: 不是实证主导论文，摘要明确说明不做全面枚举和统一实验比较，因此不应期待新的 SOTA 或干净 benchmark；价值主要在框架化整理与机制解释。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Georgios B. Giannakis，其在信号处理与优化领域较有代表性；这篇文章更像面向 SP 社区的 LoRA 技术综述。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits LoRA and related PEFT methods for large models, aiming to clarify which design choices, optimization mechanisms, and deployment constraints matter in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey/opinion-style paper rather than a new pretraining method. It is still mildly relevant at the pretrain–post-train interface, especially for understanding low-rank updates, memory bottlenecks, and the adapter design space.
summary_en.technical_approach: It reframes LoRA from a signal-processing perspective, organizing existing methods along axes such as architectural design, efficiency and system constraints, and theoretical mechanisms, while connecting them to classical low-rank modeling and inverse problems.
summary_en.experiments: This is not an empirically driven paper. The abstract explicitly says it does not aim for exhaustive empirical comparison, so one should not expect new SOTA or a clean benchmark. The value is in conceptual organization and mechanism-level interpretation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Georgios B. Giannakis, a well-known researcher in signal processing and optimization. The piece reads as a technical overview of LoRA aimed partly at the SP community.

recommendation.zh: 综述味很重，没有新实验结论；只在你要系统梳理 adapter 设计空间时有用，正文挑机制部分翻即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly a conceptual LoRA overview with little new evidence; useful only if you want a structured map of adapter design choices rather than new results.

paper.title: COMPASS: COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit performance disparities across languages, with naive multilingual fine-tuning frequently degrading performance due to negative cross-lingual interference. To address this, we introduce COMPASS (COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling), a novel data-centric framework for adapting LLMs to target languages. COMPASS leverages parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) by training lightweight, language-specific adapters on a judiciously selec

summary.core_problem: 解决多语言持续适配中常见的跨语言负迁移问题：朴素多语微调往往会伤害目标语言表现，尤其当目标分布与已有训练数据不匹配时。
summary.importance: 这是一个数据选择与持续适配问题，不是预训练范式创新。价值主要在于把“该喂哪些辅助语言数据”做成分布感知的采样策略，对 multilingual PEFT 和 continual adaptation 有一定方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 COMPASS：先用多语嵌入与聚类刻画目标使用分布和现有训练数据之间的语义缺口，再优先采样欠覆盖语义簇中的辅助多语数据，配合语言专属 PEFT adapter 训练，以提升正向迁移并减少干扰。进一步扩展为持续学习版本 COMPASS-ECDA，用于监控分布漂移并触发增量适配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据量、基线和具体提升幅度。可确认的实验主线应是：与朴素 multilingual fine-tuning / 随机采样 / 常规 PEFT 方案比较，在目标语言适配和持续分布变化场景下评估性能与干扰程度。由于缺少关键数字，当前只能视为中等可信度的应用型后训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets negative cross-lingual interference in continual multilingual adaptation, where naive multilingual fine-tuning often hurts the target language, especially under distribution mismatch.
summary_en.importance: This is a data-selection and continual adaptation paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its value lies in operationalizing which auxiliary multilingual data to use via distribution-aware sampling, which is mildly useful for multilingual PEFT and continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: COMPASS uses multilingual embeddings and clustering to measure semantic gaps between the target usage distribution and existing training data, then prioritizes auxiliary samples from under-covered semantic clusters while training lightweight language-specific PEFT adapters. COMPASS-ECDA extends this into a continual-learning setup that monitors distribution drift and triggers incremental adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baselines, or concrete gains. The likely setup compares against naive multilingual fine-tuning, random sampling, and standard PEFT baselines under target-language adaptation and continual-shift scenarios. Without hard numbers, the evidence should be treated as moderate at best.

recommendation.zh: 更像 multilingual PEFT 的数据采样技巧，不改 pretrain prior；若你做多语持续适配，只看采样定义和分布漂移触发机制即可。
recommendation.en: This looks like a multilingual PEFT data-selection trick, not a pretraining prior shift; if you work on continual multilingual adaptation, just read the sampling formulation and drift-trigger logic.

paper.title: Mining Attribute Subspaces for Efficient Fine-tuning of 3D Foundation Models

summary.core_problem: 3D 基座模型（如 VGGT）下游微调普遍依赖 LoRA，但 3D 数据的变化因素（纹理、几何、相机运动、光照等）更“属性化/可控”。核心问题是：是否存在与每类属性变化对应的 LoRA 子空间？这些子空间是否近似解耦（正交）？以及如何稳定、有效地从有限/合成数据中挖掘这些子空间，用于更高效的微调与更强的迁移。
summary.importance: 真实 3D 数据昂贵且难采集（隐私、设备、标注成本），而 3D 任务往往关注低层视觉属性。若能用可控合成数据挖掘“属性 LoRA 子空间”，就能把微调从“每任务从零学 adapter”变成“在少量共享基上学习少量系数”，提升样本效率、减少过拟合，并增强跨分布泛化（尤其对 OOD 属性组合）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步：
1) 合成数据构造（controlled variations）：为每一种属性（纹理/几何/相机/光照等）构造数据集，使目标属性变化、其他属性尽量固定；并做多个 data splits。
2) 逐 split LoRA 微调：在每个 split 上对同一 3D 基座模型（VGGT）做 LoRA 微调，得到一组 LoRA 位移矩阵 dW_i=A_iB_i^T。
3) 共享子空间提取（Shared LoRA Subspace）：假设同一属性下，不同 split 的 LoRA 更新包含“共享成分（属性相关）+ 特定成分（数据噪声/偶然因素）”。通过鲁棒的广义最小二乘目标，把多个 dW_i 共同拟合到一个低维子空间 AB^T 上：
   - 目标：min_{A,B} \sum_i ||A_iB_i^T-AB^T||_F^\alpha（\alpha 用于抑制 outlier）。
   - 用 IRLS（迭代重加权最小二乘）求解：交替更新权重 w_i 与 (A,B)。
   - 在固定 w_i 时，问题化为对加权和矩阵 C=\sum_i w_i A_iB_i^T 做截断 SVD：C=U\Sigma V^T，取前 d' 个奇异向量/值构造 A=U_{d'}\Sigma_{d'}^{1/2}, B=V_{d'}\Sigma_{d'}^{1/2}。

在得到每个属性的共享子空间后，作者评估不同属性子空间之间的近似正交性（解耦性）。最后把各属性子空间拼接/汇总，并进一步做 PCA/主成分提取，形成一个“LoRA basis”。下游新任务微调时，不再学习完整 LoRA 的 A,B，而是在该基上学习小矩阵 M：dW=\bar A M \bar B^T，从而显著减少可训练变量。
summary.experiments:
论文在多个 3D 下游任务验证：
- 微基线视频的 3D 人脸重建（含反欺骗/取证动机）；
- 宽基线图像设置下的 3D 人体重建；
- 透明物体重建。
主要结论：从合成数据挖掘的属性子空间可迁移到真实数据；用“LoRA basis + 低维 M”微调在 in-distribution 与 OOD 场景均提升效率与质量；并通过奇异值谱（文中 Fig.2 提示）给出“存在低维共享子空间”的证据，同时报告不同属性子空间的近似解耦（接近正交）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
1) Introduction：明确三大问题（是否存在属性子空间/是否解耦/如何计算）与合成数据动机。
2) Shared LoRA Subspaces 章节：
   - LoRA subspace 参数化 dW=\bar A M \bar B^T 的意义（把训练变量从 O(nr+mr) 降到 O(d'^2)）。
   - 共享子空间提取的鲁棒目标（\alpha 范数）与 IRLS 推导；固定权重时为何等价于对 C 做截断 SVD（这是算法核心）。
3) 证据与解耦分析：重点看 Fig.2（奇异值衰减是否明显）、以及属性子空间正交性度量/可视化（通常是子空间夹角、投影能量或 Gram 矩阵）。
4) 下游实验：关注 OOD 设定（属性组合变化）与参数/数据效率对比（与 vanilla LoRA、全参微调、随机子空间等基线）。

skim（泛读）：
- 先看方法图/算法框：合成数据→多次 LoRA→SVD 提取共享子空间→拼接成 basis→下游只训 M。
- 再快速看两类结果：① 奇异值谱（是否低维）；② 下游任务表格（是否在更少参数/更少数据下达到或超过 vanilla LoRA）。
summary.authors_note: 作者把 LoRA 从“每任务一个 adapter”提升为“可解释的属性子空间挖掘”：用可控合成数据把变化因素分离出来，再用鲁棒的多 LoRA 聚合（IRLS+SVD）提取共享方向，并验证不同属性方向近似解耦。最终得到可迁移的 LoRA basis，使 3D 微调更高效、更稳健。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRA is the dominant fine-tuning paradigm for 3D foundation models, but 3D data variations are strongly attribute-driven (texture, geometry, camera motion, lighting, etc.). The paper asks: (1) Do LoRA subspaces exist for each attribute type? (2) Are these subspaces disentangled (approximately orthogonal)? (3) How can we compute them robustly and use them to fine-tune efficiently with limited real 3D data?
summary_en.importance: Real-world 3D data is expensive to collect and label, while many 3D tasks depend on low-level attributes. If attribute-specific LoRA subspaces can be mined from controlled synthetic data, fine-tuning can shift from learning full adapters per task to learning a small set of coefficients within a shared basis—improving sample/parameter efficiency, reducing overfitting, and enhancing out-of-distribution generalization to new attribute combinations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Pipeline:
1) Controlled synthetic datasets: for each attribute, vary only that attribute while keeping others relatively fixed; create multiple splits.
2) LoRA fine-tune per split: obtain LoRA updates dW_i=A_iB_i^T for each split.
3) Shared subspace extraction: assume each dW_i contains a shared (attribute) component plus split-specific noise. Solve a robust generalized least-squares objective to fit all dW_i with a common low-dimensional factor AB^T:
   - min_{A,B} \sum_i ||A_iB_i^T-AB^T||_F^\alpha (\alpha improves robustness to outliers).
   - Use IRLS: alternate between updating weights w_i and updating (A,B).
   - With fixed w_i, form C=\sum_i w_i A_iB_i^T and compute truncated SVD C=U\Sigma V^T; set A=U_{d'}\Sigma_{d'}^{1/2}, B=V_{d'}\Sigma_{d'}^{1/2}.

After obtaining a shared subspace per attribute, the paper measures cross-attribute orthogonality (disentanglement). It then concatenates/aggregates attribute subspaces and applies PCA to form a compact “LoRA basis”. Downstream fine-tuning is performed within this basis via dW=\bar A M \bar B^T, where only the small matrix M is trained.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations include: (i) 3D face reconstruction from micro-baseline videos (with a forensics/anti-spoofing motivation), (ii) 3D human reconstruction under wide-baseline images, and (iii) transparent object reconstruction. Reported findings: singular-value spectra (e.g., Fig.2) support low-dimensional shared structure; attribute subspaces are approximately disentangled; and the mined basis transfers from synthetic to real data, improving both in-distribution and OOD performance with fewer trainable parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
1) Introduction: the three core questions and why controlled synthetic data is key.
2) Shared LoRA Subspaces section:
   - The subspace parameterization dW=\bar A M \bar B^T and its parameter-count implications.
   - The robust objective (\alpha) and the IRLS solver; why the weighted problem reduces to truncated SVD of C.
3) Evidence + disentanglement: inspect Fig.2 (singular value decay) and the orthogonality/subspace-angle metrics.
4) Downstream results: focus on OOD setups and efficiency comparisons vs vanilla LoRA/full fine-tuning/random subspaces.

skim (quick read):
- Read the method overview/algorithm box: synthetic control → multiple LoRAs → SVD shared subspace → concatenate to basis → train only M.
- Skim Fig.2 and the main performance tables for parameter/data efficiency gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper reframes LoRA fine-tuning as mining interpretable, transferable attribute subspaces. Controlled synthetic variations isolate factors; robust aggregation (IRLS + SVD) extracts shared directions; subspaces are shown to be approximately disentangled; and a compact LoRA basis enables efficient and robust fine-tuning on new 3D tasks.

recommendation.zh: 只读属性LoRA子空间“近似正交/可组合”的证据与挖掘流程；若可信，你可以把3D微调改成学少量系数而非新adapter。
recommendation.en: Skim the evidence that attribute LoRA subspaces are near-orthogonal/composable and the mining procedure; if credible, it suggests switching 3D finetuning to learning a few coefficients instead of new adapters.

paper.title: New Hybrid Fine-Tuning Paradigm for LLMs: Algorithm Design and Convergence Analysis Framework

summary.core_problem: LLM 微调主要有两条路线：全参数微调（效果强但计算/显存昂贵）与 PEFT（如 LoRA，成本低但学习新知识能力弱、效果上限受限）。同时，零阶（ZO）全参微调可避免反向传播但收敛慢。论文要解决的问题是：能否设计一种同时更新“基座模型参数 + PEFT 模块”的混合微调范式，在不显著增加资源开销的前提下兼顾适配能力与优化效率，并给出可解释、可证明的收敛理论。
summary.importance: 该工作试图把工程上常见但理论缺位的“混合更新”系统化：在大模型场景中，单纯 FO 全参微调成本过高；单纯 PEFT 容易学不到新知识；单纯 ZO 全参微调又慢。若能用 ZO 更新大子空间（基座）以降低梯度计算负担，同时用 FO 更新小子空间（PEFT）以加速收敛，就可能在成本与效果之间取得更优折中。更重要的是，论文提出“hybrid smoothness condition”来刻画联合优化的异质光滑性，为后续混合优化算法的理论分析提供通用框架。
summary.technical_approach:
论文提出 Hybrid Fine-Tuning：将参数分为两部分 x（基座 LLM 参数）与 y（PEFT 模块参数），联合最小化经验风险，但采用异构优化器：
- 对 x 使用 Zeroth-Order（ZO）更新：通过函数值扰动近似梯度，避免对整个大模型做反向传播，从而降低计算/显存压力，并允许基座参数真正更新以学习新知识。
- 对 y 使用 First-Order（FO）更新：对小规模 PEFT 模块直接用梯度法（如 SGD/Adam）更新，以弥补 ZO 的高方差与慢收敛问题。
为支撑该算法，论文提出理论框架：
1) Hybrid smoothness condition（定义 1）：刻画联合参数空间中不同子空间具有不同（且可能动态变化的）局部光滑性/梯度 Lipschitz 常数的情形，反映“基座 vs. PEFT”在尺度与结构上的异质性。
2) 在该更一般的损失类下，给出带 Random Reshuffling 的 SGD 收敛分析（定理 1），并声称将标准光滑损失下的最优样本复杂度保证推广到 hybrid smooth loss function class，用以解释学习率选择与收敛速度在混合结构中的行为。
summary.experiments: 论文在 3 种架构、6 个任务共 18 个 model-task 组合上做实验：Hybrid fine-tuning 在 94.5% 的组合（17/18）上取得最高准确率；Figure 4 展示更快收敛；Table 2 声称相对 FO 对照不增加额外显存开销。整体结论是：混合更新在效果上优于纯 PEFT/纯 ZO 全参等基线，并在训练动态上更高效。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
- Introduction：抓住三者矛盾（全参贵、PEFT 学不到新知识、ZO 慢）与核心方案（x 用 ZO、y 用 FO）。
- “Hybrid Fine-Tuning and Hybrid Smoothness Condition”章节：精读参数分解形式、算法更新规则（ZO 梯度估计如何构造、与 FO 更新如何交替/同步）、以及 Definition 1 的 hybrid smoothness 精确定义（这是理论贡献的地基）。
- 理论部分重点：定理 1（SGD + Random Reshuffling 在 hybrid smoothness 下的收敛）——建议对照其假设条件（光滑性、噪声、有界性等）、结论形式（迭代复杂度/样本复杂度）、以及与标准 smooth 情形的差异。
- 图表优先级：Figure 1(a) 动态 Lipschitz 现象；Figure 1(b) 基座与 LoRA 的异质 Lipschitz 对比；Figure 3/Table 1 主结果；Figure 4 收敛曲线；Table 2 显存对比。
- 创新点提炼：①混合范式（ZO 更新基座 + FO 更新 PEFT）；②提出 hybrid smoothness 条件以刻画异质结构；③在该条件下给出 Random Reshuffling SGD 的收敛框架与保证。

skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 只看 Introduction + 贡献点：记住“基座用 ZO、PEFT 用 FO”的混合更新思想。
- 快速看 Figure 1(a)(b)：理解为什么需要新的 smoothness 描述。
- 只扫 Table 1/Figure 3：确认 18 组实验中 17 组最优（94.5%）。
summary.authors_note: 作者试图把一个直觉很强的工程折中（大子空间用便宜但粗糙的 ZO，小子空间用精确的 FO）上升为可分析的优化范式，并强调现有理论无法覆盖“动态变化 + 子空间异质”的光滑性结构，因此提出 hybrid smoothness 作为统一刻画，再在此基础上补齐 Random Reshuffling SGD 的收敛分析缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM fine-tuning is dominated by two extremes: full fine-tuning (strong adaptation but very expensive) and PEFT (cheap but often weak at learning new knowledge and can underperform). Zeroth-order (ZO) full fine-tuning avoids backprop but converges slowly. The paper asks whether we can design a hybrid paradigm that jointly updates both the base model and PEFT modules—achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs—while providing a principled convergence analysis for such heterogeneous optimization.
summary_en.importance: The work systematizes a practical but under-theorized idea: in large models, FO full fine-tuning is costly; PEFT may fail to acquire new knowledge; ZO full fine-tuning is slow. A hybrid approach—ZO on the large base-parameter subspace and FO on the small PEFT subspace—could reduce compute/memory while retaining adaptation power. The proposed “hybrid smoothness condition” aims to become a reusable theoretical lens for joint LLM+PEFT optimization where smoothness is heterogeneous and can change during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes Hybrid Fine-Tuning by partitioning parameters into x (base LLM) and y (PEFT module) and optimizing the empirical loss with heterogeneous optimizers:
- Update x with Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization: estimate gradients via function-value perturbations, avoiding full backprop through the entire LLM, enabling base-parameter updates to learn new knowledge with reduced overhead.
- Update y with First-Order (FO) optimization: directly use gradients for the small PEFT module to mitigate ZO’s variance and slow convergence.
For theory, it introduces:
1) Hybrid smoothness condition (Definition 1): a generalized smoothness notion capturing heterogeneous (and potentially dynamically changing) local Lipschitz/gradient smoothness across the x and y subspaces.
2) A unified convergence framework under this condition, including a convergence result for SGD with Random Reshuffling (Theorem 1), claiming to extend optimal sample-complexity guarantees from standard smooth losses to the broader hybrid-smooth loss class.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span 18 model-task combinations (3 architectures × 6 tasks). Hybrid fine-tuning achieves the best accuracy in 94.5% of cases (17/18). Figure 4 reports faster convergence behavior, and Table 2 claims no additional memory overhead compared to the FO counterpart. Overall, the hybrid method outperforms pure PEFT and pure ZO full fine-tuning baselines while improving training dynamics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + what to focus on)
- Introduction: understand the tri-lemma (full FT expensive, PEFT weak for new knowledge, ZO slow) and the core hybrid solution (ZO for x, FO for y).
- “Hybrid Fine-Tuning and Hybrid Smoothness Condition”: read carefully for the exact parameterization, update rules (how ZO gradient estimates are formed; how FO/ZO are combined), and the precise statement of Definition 1.
- Theory: focus on Theorem 1 (SGD + Random Reshuffling under hybrid smoothness)—check assumptions, rates/sample complexity, and how it differs from classical smooth-loss analyses.
- Figures/Tables to prioritize: Figure 1(a) dynamic Lipschitz behavior; Figure 1(b) heterogeneous Lipschitz across base vs. LoRA; Figure 3/Table 1 main accuracy results; Figure 4 convergence curves; Table 2 memory comparison.
- Key innovations: (i) hybrid FO/ZO fine-tuning (ZO base + FO PEFT); (ii) hybrid smoothness condition; (iii) convergence framework for Random Reshuffling SGD in this generalized setting.

skim (high-level + what to read)
- Read Introduction + contributions: remember “ZO updates the base; FO updates PEFT”.
- Glance at Figure 1(a)(b) for motivation of new smoothness modeling.
- Skim Table 1/Figure 3 to confirm 17/18 best (94.5%).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors elevate an intuitive engineering compromise—cheap but noisy ZO on the large subspace, accurate FO on the small subspace—into a formal fine-tuning paradigm, arguing existing convergence theory does not cover dynamically changing and heterogeneous smoothness. They propose hybrid smoothness as the unifying condition and use it to fill a gap in convergence analysis for SGD with Random Reshuffling.

recommendation.zh: 混合用ZO更基座+FO更LoRA的思路工程上可能省账，但理论框架未必能落到大模型细节；只看算法伪码与收敛假设，判断是否只是“可证明但不可用”。
recommendation.en: ZO-on-backbone + FO-on-PEFT could be cost-effective, but the theory may not survive real LLM details; skim the algorithm box and convergence assumptions to see if it’s provable-yet-impractical.
